202001.name: Forging Stone I
202001.description: Recycle Lvl. 1-60 Equipment to obtain. It can be used to forge Lvl.1-60 Equipment.
202001.comment: A basic forging stone, ideal for beginners in equipment forging.

202002.name: Forging Stone II
202002.description: Recycle Lvl. 55-105 Equipment to obtain. It can be used to forge Lvl.65-105 Equipment.
202002.comment: A common forging stone with descent quality that is essential for equipment forging.

202003.name: Forging Stone IV
202003.description: Recycle Lvl. 100-145 Equipment to obtain. It can be used to forge Lvl.110-145 Equipment.
202003.comment: A refined forging stone with a considerable price and quality.

202007.name: Forging Stone V
202007.description: Recycle Lvl. 140-185 Equipment to obtain. It can be used to forge Lvl.150-185 Equipment.
202007.comment: High quality forging stones are hard to find on the market.

202008.name: Forging Stone VII
202008.description: Recycle Lvl. 180-240 Equipment to obtain. It can be used to forge Lvl.190-240 Equipment.
202008.comment: A precious forging stone imbued with divine power, and its scarcity is the only drawback.

203001.name: Impure Divine Ash
203001.description: Used to enhance hero skills. Theoretically, it boosts strength, but in practice, it demands a substantial accumulation of magical essence for effectiveness, and results vary among individuals.

205001.name: Starlight Cup
205001.description: A teacup adorned with the emblem of the stars is the most popular gift in the Lightbearer Empire. Gifting it to a hero can increase their affinity.

220001.description: A spell for when you want a huge haul. Just make sure you've cleared some storage first, or you may end up with more than you can carry.

220002.name: Quick Growth Spell
220002.description: A spell that tricks seeds into thinking they've overslept, making them rush to mature. Best pair it with a spell that keeps seeds in a good mood before they realize they've been fooled.

220003.name: Magnification Spell
220003.description: A spell that makes the target puff up like a balloon with a single tap. Sadly, it still refuses to work on gold, gems, or anything else people actually want more of.

220004.name: Whirlpull Spell
220004.description: A spell that makes everything nearby roll helplessly into one spinning pile. Very handy in open space. Less handy if you're standing in the middle of the mess.

220005.name: Time Rewind Spell
220005.description: A wonderfully practical spell for covering your mistakes. Works just as well on broken objects as it does on awkward moments.

220006.name: Stonepass Spell
220006.description: A spell that lets you zip from one spot to another. Where you land, though, is another matter—you might pop into a treasure room full of chests, or straight into a monster's mouth.

220007.name: Petrification Spell
220007.description: A spell that makes any surface hard as stone. Supposedly, it was inspired by a dwarf who never once lost a headbutting contest with a wall.

220008.name: Verdant Vitality Spell
220008.description: This spell won't work miracles, but it does make each ear of grain come in a little fuller. For plenty of farmers, that small difference is enough to make for a fine harvest.

220009.name: Nature's Grace Spell
220009.description: A spell that loads trees up with extra fruit until the branches start to sag under the weight. The trees may not appreciate it, but every fruit-loving critter nearby certainly will.

220010.name: Fertile Bond Spell
220010.description: A spell that sometimes gives you an extra plant along with the one you grew. It has that oddly satisfying feeling of getting a bonus when you weren't expecting one.

252001.name: Warrior's Guarantee
252001.description: An energy-imbued gemstone that is required to enter the Arena.

801005.name: Superior Apple
801005.description: The bright red apple and its sweet juices are so tempting.

801006.name: Rotten Apple
801006.description: Just smelling these rotten apples makes me want to vomit...

801043.name: Wild Hexaflower
801043.description: The most common seasoning in the land. It is sweet and can be eaten directly, or it can be dried and ground into a seasoning powder.

801044.name: Wild Glowfly Fruit
801044.description: A translucent wild berry from the Dark Forest that has a bitter taste. It has an unexpected unique flavor after it was transplanted to the Lightbearer Empire.

801045.name: Wild Wisteria Vine
801045.description: A common vine that grows on tall trees or stone walls. It bears a fruit called the Butterfly Pea, which can be peeled to reveal a sweet fruit jelly that looks like gold sand.

801046.name: Wild Radish
801046.description: A wild vegetable that is common in the plains. Its flesh is refreshing and spicy, and it can be eaten raw. In some areas where the harvest is poor and resources are lacking, radish is the main vegetable consumed by local residents.

801047.name: Wild Rainbow Flower
801047.description: According to legends, this plant only blooms when a rainbow appears. It mostly grows under trees in forests and on shady slopes, and blooms when exposed to light after rain.

801274.name: Wild Honeyberry
801274.description: Unique fruit grown in mountainous regions. Abundant sunlight has made them very sweet and far tastier than the usual wild berries.

801291.name: Lost Glyph
801291.description: A secret glyph dropped by a female Adamant Syndicate Mage.
801291.story:
Note:
The code word to open the trap door is—The <style="stress">figure</style> held upward, the <style="stress">right hand</style> stretched forward, and the <style="stress">sword</style> swung downward.

801292.name: Eliza's Ledger
801292.description: A ledger hidden deep in the tunnel.
801292.story:
Expenses:
New feathered hat - 5,000 gold
Hair styling - 500 gold
Hiring fighters - 50,000 gold
Fixing this damn tunnel to keep me from being squashed - 20,000 gold

Income:
Setting the village on fire for Lord Franz - 200,000 gold

I'm sick of this tunnel already! The stench of old drinks and gold is smothering me! More perfume isn't gonna make it any better.
I wish Lady Illucia could get me a better posting or at least send me somewhere more appealing...

801293.name: Vital Herb
801293.description: An herb capable of remitting discomfort.

801294.name: Top Secret
801294.comment: An important piece of evidence at the fire scene.
801294.story:
Top Secret
<style="stress">Burn this letter after you read it</style>

The lord has been left with no choice but to pull out this plan because the stubborn Northville villagers refused to grow Gemvine grapes. They will have to agree to our terms once Northville loses its source of income. It's regrettable for the lord that things have come to this point. Failure is not an option!

Step 1: Lazell and his people disguise themselves as Northville villagers, sneak into the village, spread kerosene around, find a hiding spot, and wait for a signal from the mage!
Step 2: The mage will summon a fire elemental to make the fire look like an accident. If the fire isn't intense enough, you need to add more firewood to make it blaze!

Note: Hogan is a tough nut to crack. Just in case, it's best to find a scapegoat. Be smart and act on the fly!

As dusk approaches, the villagers will be preparing dinner. <style="stress">That's the time to move!</style>

801295.name: Warming Potion
801295.description: The magic potion delivered to the shivering soldiers by the magic shop owner.

801296.name: Cassadee's Notes
801296.description: Notes related to the construction of Cassadee's magic circle.
801296.comment: The complicated notes seem to have been written casually, but the word "Merlin" was written with special care.
801296.story:
...This is the main part of the magic circle, which requires 5 sets of blue manastones. They form a magic design that connects with Merlin's specially designed magic stabilizer to ensure the stability of the spell weave. I have streamlined the magic circle. Should I make some more adjustments accordingly?

I've conducted two additional experiments. Although the streamlined structure utilizing two sets of blue manastones proved to be more convenient to use. However, theoretically, the five-set configuration offers a higher magical capacity. More importantly, it's Merlin's own design!

It's decided! I'll use the five-set structure!

801297.name: Bay Twig
801297.description: A twig that seems to contain magic.

801298.name: Golem Material
801298.description: Parts of the golem's body, when damaged, fall off. I've heard scholars from the Evergreen Conservatory are collecting them for research.

801301.name: Bag of Scarlet Pomes
801301.description: A bag full of ripe and delicious scarlet pomes.

801302.name: Bag of Hexaflowers
801302.description: A bag of hexaflower leaves. Brew zesty, special tea with Grandma Mera's recipe!

801303.name: Dewdrop Potion
801303.description: A potion brewed by a blend of Hewynn's dewdrops with the local herbs in Taran. It smells delightful and has magical healing power.

801304.name: Lovers Wreath
801304.description: Traditionally, Taran residents wear a wreath when building romance. This one is made from flowers gathered along the Lovers' Wish.
801304.comment: May your future be as blooming as the floral wreath.

801306.name: Detective Eleray
801306.description: This is the latest edition of the novel series "The Great Adventures of Detective Eleray", which is currently popular in the Lightbearer Empire. It describes the thrilling tales of a seagull named Eleray, the greatest detective of the animal kingdom.
801306.story:
... Eleray felt the feathers beneath his wings tremble slightly, a manifestation of his intuitive awareness when facing conundrums created by his suspects. As usual, he should have picked up his beloved pipe and taken a hearty puff, but now he could only grab two tavern fries and stuff them into his typically eloquent yellow beak—whose remarkable color matched the fries extraordinarily well.

It was better than nothing. He thought.

Like the case at hand, his small agency, and his supposed identity as a great detective—with the absence of his pipe, everything else appeared to be of little consequence.

801307.name: Bluebell
801307.description: A cluster of verdant bluebells where the legendary messengers of Misarte, blue butterflies, linger around.

801308.name: Blue Caterpillar
801308.description: Baby blue butterflies feed on bluebells. They undergo metamorphosis into butterflies after 12 instars. It ferments the bluebell nectar and locks it in its body, whose extract can be a precious dye.
801308.comment:
A young messenger of Misarte, a sacred and graceful creature...
D-don't come any closer, whatever you are!

801309.name: Sylvan Egg
801309.description: An incarnation of Misarte. It is a sacred artifact given by the Deer Spirit. The looming glow suggests the vibrant life force inside.

801310.name: Sweet Fruit
801310.description: Wild fruits grown in the Vaduso Mountains with sweet and juicy flavors.
801310.comment: It is torture not to eat it.

801311.name: Healing Herbs
801311.description: Common wild herbs from the Vaduso Mountains. It can cool the pain away and stop bleeding when crushed and applied to wounds.

801312.name: Fresh Magic Sprouts
801312.description: Fresh sprouts specially harvested from mana sprites. If handled improperly, these sprouts can instantly wither and be completely useless.
801312.comment: Swear to Misarte, not a single mana sprite was harmed during the harvest!

801313.name: Golden Smelling Salts
801313.description: A mix of golden honey and magic sprouts, antler brew, golden mints, thornweed, and many other ingredients. Its healing effects are so strong that it can even awaken the deepest sleepers.

801314.name: Golden Honey
801314.description: A special honey gathered from the hornleaf bear's den. It is thicker and denser in texture than regular honey and shows a subtle rainbow glow in the light.

801315.name: Warrant
801315.description: The crumpled paper, with a canteen's purchase order on the front, has a hastily scrawled retreat command on the back in very sloppy handwriting.
801315.comment: Seems like it was hastily written on the back of a randomly acquired document.
801315.story:
[Withdrawal Order - No. 1315]

In accordance with this order, all squad leaders are to execute commands immediately!
Squads 1-5, evacuate immediately and stand by at the backup camp!

Perimeter patrol teams, stand by on-site. Until further notice, do not initiate contact or return to the base camp!

The reserve team is to be stationed within the camp according to plan 3-2. Until further notice, do not leave the camp without authorization!

Issued by: —— (illegible seal)

801316.name: Confidential Info
801316.description: A well-printed booklet, even featuring a bright red cover, but seemingly repurposed as a coaster for soup bowls, now soaked with oil stains. The pages are stuck together, and many of the words have become difficult to discern.
801316.story:
Dear Fellow Syndicate Members:

Recently, we've observed internal discussions within the chamber regarding changes in senior personnel. Unfortunately, these discussions have given rise to unrealistic speculations and misleading information. Regrettably, some of this misinformation has seeped beyond the Syndicate's confines, creating highly inappropriate repercussions for both the Syndicate's reputation and the information pertaining to senior personnel.

We hereby reiterate that the Unveiler, Illucia, holds a vital managerial role within the Syndicate. Specific details about her schedule, encompassing attendance and meetings, are classified as sensitive information within the Syndicate's boundaries and should not be discussed in any public setting.

We regret to inform you that members involved in the aforementioned procedural violations will be subject to disciplinary measures.

Let this serve as a warning to all members.

—Adamant Syndicate

Attached is the list of personnel to be dealt with.
George Schmidt: Level Three Supervisor. Action Plan: —
Charlotte Bell: Level One Business Officer. Action Plan: —
Anthony Brooks: Level Four Supervisor. Action Plan: —

(The back pages of the booklet are filled with various crossed-out names.)

801317.name: Notice
801317.description: A notice printed on high-quality paper, still seemingly emanating the warmth of fresh ink—though it has been carelessly stepped on a few times, giving it a somewhat disheveled appearance.
801317.story:
Adamant Syndicate Directors and Colleagues: 

In accordance with the latest notification and to ensure the security and integrity of the Syndicate's research and development, a decision has been made to destroy certain immovable data and records.

Locations: Around the Sun Temple, in addition to camps 1, 2, and 8.
Extent: Includes physical documents, components, and finished products not covered by the relocation notice or confirmed as immovable; if necessary, relevant personnel may be included without the need for additional approval.
Destruction Requirements: Total annihilation; if unable to be completely obliterated, must reach an irrecoverable and unidentifiable state.
Destruction Timeframe: Commencing immediately upon receipt of the notice.
Means of Destruction: Each camp is responsible for organizing and arranging methods.
Responsible Personnel: Each camp is responsible for organizing and arranging manpower.

Please be advised of the above notice and ensure prompt completion of destruction, withdrawal of personnel upon completion, and site cleanup.

Adamant Syndicate

801318.name: Gruglin Club
801318.description: The large club wielded by gruglins.
801318.comment: It's the best material for mechanisms!

801319.name: Overripe Fruit
801319.description: Rare juice made from fully ripened glowfly fruit.
801319.comment: The bridge will surely thrive with the gift from nature.

801320.name: Hewynn's Dewdrops
801320.description: The water sprite, Hewynn, has gathered a substantial amount of healing magic inside them. You can almost hear murmurs when holding them close to your ear.
801320.comment: It sounds like Miss Hewynn's voice...

801321.name: Hornleaf Bear's Leaf
801321.description: The leaves growing on the chests of hornleaf bears are surprisingly soft to the touch compared to their wild look.

801322.name: Quickvine
801322.description: A peculiar vine that can sprout in seconds with enough water and nutrients, commonly found in temperate broadleaf forests. Its flexible yet robust texture often makes it a preferred material among the Wilders of the jungle.

801323.name: Half-Complete Prostheses
801323.description: Damian made this prosthesis for Korin from the quickvine of the Dark Forest to perfectly reproduce the tendon's structure based on plant fibers. But he says the prosthesis still needs to be improved before it can be put into use.

801324.name: Teleportation Script
801324.description: One of Parisa's spellbook scripts. It is neatly inscribed with an incantation for teleportation. Though usable only once, it allows one to travel across vast distances and instantly arrive at the desired location.
801324.comment: Head to where the flowers bloom.

801328.name: Letter to Miria
801328.description: A letter from Erlan of Slopeville to Miria of Taran.
801328.comment: After a long wait, the journey begins.

801329.name: Conservatory Research Notes
801329.description: This is a notebook provided by the Evergreen Conservatory to Indina and Karlson. It documents important survey records.

801335.name: Antler Flute
801335.description: A uniquely carved wooden flute that, when played, emits a sound similar to deer calls. It can be surprisingly helpful in attracting the attention of nearby small animals.
801335.comment: So, this is what I need to bring the deer home?

801336.name: Reviving Elixir
801336.description: A potion that gives off a reviving and chilling scent. Its ingredients remain a mystery.
801336.comment: For emergency use only. Not to be consumed as a beverage.

801337.name: Gleamtail
801337.description: A rodent species native to the Vaduso Mountains, arboreal and fond of legumes and nuts. Their fur emits a subtle glow at night due to special glands in their body.
801337.comment: Aww! Look at those wiggling ears!

801340.name: Yolanda's Hexaflower
801340.description: Common spice grown by Yolanda of Lunadorf.

801348.name: Wisteria Vine
801348.description: A common vine plant. One of the favorite foods of gleamtails and perfect for trapping them.

801354.name: Deformed Glowfly Fruit
801354.description: A deformed fruit found in Ivoryshade with a tough shell. It cannot be eaten raw but can be used to set up asymmetrical magic circles.

801355.name: Honeyberry
801355.description: A round fruit found in Ivoryshade with a strong, sweet scent. Can be used to set up asymmetrical magic circles.

801356.name: Rainbow Flower
801356.description: Common flowers found in Ivoryshade. Can be used to set up asymmetrical magic circles.

801370.name: Bay Twig
801370.description: Common bay twigs found in Ivoryshade. Can be used to set up asymmetrical magic circles.

801374.name: Joy Plane
801374.description: Attend the <style="highlight">Joyous Feast</style> during the Astral Fair. You can find Zini and take the joy plane for a test flight to earn <style="highlight">Stellar Crystals</style>. Ribbons, fireworks, and gifts will drop from the plane as it flies.
801374.comment: The wooden plane modified by Damian. Ribbons, fireworks, and gifts will drop from the plane and scatter around as it flies, making it an essential item for celebrations.

801375.name: Med-Hexaflower
801375.description: A special type of med-hexaflower required by Granny Dahnie. It is more bitter and has more medicinal effects.
801375.comment: Hopefully Aves 11 can get well after eating this.

801376.name: Med-Rainbow Flower
801376.description: A special type of med-rainbow flower required by Granny Dahnie. It is not fully bloomed yet and has more medicinal effects.
801376.comment: Hopefully Aves 11 can get well after eating this.

801377.name: Med-Glowfly Fruit
801377.description: A special type of med-glowfly fruit required by Granny Dahnie. It feels harder, tastes sharper, and is often used for medicinal purposes.
801377.comment: Hopefully Aves 11 can get well after eating this.

801385.name: Bird Sculpture
801385.description: A smooth marble sculpture of a bird gazing upward, capturing a moment of serene grace.
801385.comment: This item appears to have some connection to the identity of Aves 11...

801444.name: Joy Plane
801444.description: The wooden plane modified by Damian. Ribbons, fireworks, and gifts will drop from the plane and scatter around as it flies. You can earn <style="highlight">Stellar Crystals</style> by releasing joy planes during the <style="highlight">Joyous Feast</style>.

801445.name: Sugarbead
801445.description: Wild berries from Golden Wheatshire, soft and juicy. Perfect for a sweet, tangy, jam, but difficult to store.

801446.name: Grain Balls
801446.description: A sticky snack of grains bound with jam, irresistible to small birds.

801517.name: Ryeham Flour
801517.description: The finest flour just arrived from Ryeham. It's perfect for baking the biggest, fluffiest cake you can dream up.

801518.name: Premium Honey
801518.description: Rich, refined honey with a thick, sweet taste and a fresh floral scent. Heidi put in a lot of effort to save enough for a special occasion—most of it was to not eat it all herself.

801519.name: Firefly Berries
801519.description: Freshly harvested glowfly fruit. Its bitterness has never stopped gruglins from making it their staple food.

801520.name: Large Apples
801520.description: The Gruglin Chief's personal stash—these are the juiciest, most flavorful apples you'll find anywhere.

801521.name: Magic Cloth
801521.description: A rare fabric infused with powerful enchantments and soaked in a unique compound. Naturally shimmering with dazzling colors, its weavers imbue it with magic to shift hues and styles to suit any occasion.

801522.name: Gift Wrappings
801522.description: Exclusive packaging materials provided by the Mithril Consortium. Adorned with elegant ribbons and charming decorative touches, these wraps give every gift a refined, festive flair.

801523.name: Ironhoof's Weapon Oil
801523.description: A rough-and-ready weapon oil from Bowa Ironhoof's tribe. It might be cheap, but it's incredibly effective—perfect for keeping weapons in top shape. A trusted favorite among Maulers for its raw reliability.

801524.name: Gift for Mirael
801524.description: A gift for Mirael. Wonder how she'll react?

801525.name: Special Weapon Oil
801525.description: Building on the foundation of Bowa Ironhoof's weapon oil, you've added your own expert touch, transforming it into oils tailored to different needs.

801526.name: Gift for Hogan
801526.description: A gift for General Hogan. He'll surely like this one.

801527.name: Gift for Valen
801527.description: A gift for Valen. What kind of joke will he come up with this time?

801528.name: Gift for Chippy
801528.description: A gift for Chippy. I think this will leave him speechless!

801529.name: Gift for Dolly
801529.description: A gift for Dolly. Fingers crossed it's something she'll love.

801530.name: Gift for Hammie
801530.description: A gift for Hammie. Can't wait to see the smile this brings!

801531.name: Merlin's Winter Cake
801531.description: Flour from Ryeham, rich honey, and sweet, juicy apples—baked to perfection in Mirael's expertly tuned flames. This is how you turn a cake into a masterpiece!

1252002.name: Glory Badge
1252002.description: An energy-imbued badge for access to the Supreme Arena.

1801325.name: Explosives
1801325.description: Common explosives with moderate power. Can be used to clear obstructions like fences and wooden barricades.

1801326.name: Tomb Key
1801326.description: There appears to be more than one secret key hidden deep in the resting place of the Dusk Lord, which can open magically sealed doors.

1801330.name: Entrance Pass
1801330.description: Granted by Mikola, grants access to the rear entrance of Sunseek Arena.

1801331.name: Spider Egg
1801331.description: The sand spider egg serves as proof of the completion of the Trial of Blood.

1801332.name: Wolf's Fang
1801332.description: The sharp fangs of wild desert wolves, often used in crafting necklaces, can only be obtained by powerful warriors.

1801333.name: Terrabird Plume
1801333.description: The plumage of terrabirds, commonly used in crafting necklaces, can only be obtained by agile warriors.

1801334.name: Kom Grass
1801334.description: The branches and leaves are resilient after processing, they're often used in crafting knots and ornaments.

1801339.name: Necklace
1801339.description: Crafted from the teeth of unique desert beasts. It symbolizes the wearer's unmatched strength, wisdom, and courage.

1801341.name: Beasthoof
1801341.description: Maulers began using this healing herb after noticing its healing effects on various beasts of the desert.

1801343.name: Empty Vessel
1801343.description: Beautiful, transparent glassware, perfect for storing liquids or displaying flowers.
1801343.comment: However, it was purchased solely to contain snake venom.

1801344.name: Spider Venom
1801344.description: Indigenous to the Crimson Highlands and incredibly toxic. However, when used in trace amounts, it can also be concocted into invaluable medicine.

1801345.name: Milk Thistle
1801345.description: Precious fruit grown in the wilderness of the Eroded Enclave. When cut, exudes a milky substance which can neutralize many toxins when mixed appropriately.

1801346.name: Smudged Letter
1801346.description: A soiled handwritten letter with incomplete script, detailing the grievances and aspirations of someone's life. Signed by Gali, a familiar name.
1801346.comment: Gali... The same Gali from the Evergreen Conservatory?
1801346.story:
Mother, I've been thinking of you. Do you think as life nears its end, we become more fragile? Like larvae in a cocoon, never to hatch, they simply fade away in silence and solitude.

You said that one must learn to admit weakness, and so I remembered every cry and every prayer from earlier days. Now I am praying, Mother, as you taught me to pray.

The people I was with are gone, hunted by spiders or lost to thirst, but I'm alive. I want to keep living.

Mother, how I want to stay in Alkali and be with you... There's so much more I want to do... (some of the text is smudged)

<align="right">(Smudged text)<style="highlight"> Gali, of the Evergreen Conservatory</style>

1801347.name: Elegant Necklace
1801347.description: Adorned with animal fangs and large prism ignis along with several jade accents. It appears to have been meticulously cleaned and stored.

1801349.name: Wild Blazing Orchid
1801349.description: The leaves of this plant resemble flames. It's surprisingly abundant in juice, so it's often used for brewing beverages.
1801349.comment: Can be found in the world. The fire is merely an illusion.

1801350.name: Wild Scorpion Stinger
1801350.description: It's named for its resemblance to a scorpion's stinger, though it's harmless. The first brave person to consume a scorpion stinger remains unknown.
1801350.comment: Guaranteed to give any kid the heebie-jeebies with its eerie aura! If you don't like kids, this is your plant.

1801351.name: Wild Snakebone Grass
1801351.description: Frequently buried in yellow sand during the day, resembling dried snake bones, it emits a green light upon contact with water.
1801351.comment: It's been said that it's good for making soup...

1801352.name: Wild Wanderfruit
1801352.description: Despite its tough shell, cracking it open reveals a refreshing and delicious juice, beloved by travelers.
1801352.comment: Behold the H2O-asis! It saves parched souls one sip at a time.

1801353.name: Wild Sandstone Nut
1801353.description: A drought-resistant shrub whose fruit is rich in oil, crispy, slightly salty, making it an excellent snack for replenishing energy and salt.
1801353.comment: The only fruit that makes you say, "Ouch!" and "Yum!" in the same bite!

1801365.name: Flexible Tumbleweed
1801365.description: A common desert plant. It often vanishes after a gust of wind and reappears somewhere far away afterward.

1801366.name: Buckthorn Caravan's Treasures
1801366.description: The treasures stolen by the bandits. The chest looks like it has been pried open before, but it is still heavy.

1801367.name: Snakebone Grass
1801367.description: Dried snakebone grass is more potent and can be made into a wider variety of medicines when ground into powder.

1801368.name: Giant Blazing Orchid
1801368.description: Blazing orchid used for the offering.

1801372.name: Snakebone Grass
1801372.description: A plant that grows in the desert that can be used as medicine after being ground into powder.

2026041.name: Bubble Bait
2026041.description: Used at Avalon fishing spots to attract round-bodied fish.
2026041.comment: This nest, with circular holes, attracts round-bodied fish.

2026042.name: Slender Bait
2026042.description: Used at Avalon fishing spots to attract long-bodied fish.
2026042.comment: This nest, with elongated holes, attracts long-bodied fish.

2026043.name: Carrion Bait
2026043.description: Used at Avalon fishing spots to attract carnivorous fish.
2026043.comment: This nest, made of decayed meat, attracts carnivorous fish.

2026044.name: Seaweed Bait
2026044.description: Used at Avalon fishing spots to attract mimic fish.
2026044.comment: This nest, warm and filled with seaweed, attracts mimic fish.

2026045.name: Cavernous Bait
2026045.description: Used at Avalon fishing spots to attract other aquatic creatures.
2026045.comment: This nest is large and spacious. While not a safe refuge from predators, it holds a special appeal for certain aquatic creatures.

2026046.name: Deepwater Timber
2026046.comment: This strong, resilient wood can be found in deep waters.

2026047.name: Sticky Vine
2026047.comment: This vine is common in regions where the Graveborn gather. Once dead, the vines stick together, and their fibrous threads are perfect for making glue.

2026048.name: Steel Root
2026048.comment: These underground roots are incredibly tough and able to withstand intense heat.

2026049.name: Marshbed Clay
2026049.comment: This rare clay is found only in the deepest parts of swamps.

2026050.name: Spark Fungus
2026050.comment: This mushroom releases glittering red spores.

2026051.name: Red Honeyfruit
2026051.comment: This bright red fruit produces thick, sticky juice.

2026052.name: Torch Tree Bark
2026052.comment: This reddish-brown bark can be processed into paper through extended boiling or used to grind teeth.

2026053.name: Rainbow Salt
2026053.comment: These dazzling gems are actually just rocks, which can be processed into powders of different colors.

2026054.name: Magma Clam
2026054.comment: This shellfish, which thrives in magma, contains the energy of a fire elemental.

2026055.name: Ashflint
2026055.comment: Covered by ash and sparks, this stone holds magic that keeps flames burning forever.

2026056.name: Flamepetal
2026056.comment: This flower is said to make flames more vivid, with petals shaped like flowing lava.

2026057.name: Charged Core
2026057.description: Upgrade material for Emberlight Banquet fishing rod.
2026057.comment: Struck by lightning and fallen into water, these logs reveal a tough, durable core when stripped of bark.

2026058.name: Densenut
2026058.description: Upgrade material for Emberlight Banquet fishing rod.
2026058.comment: This nut has a shell so tough that even roasting won't crack it.

2026059.name: Cindercore
2026059.description: Upgrade material for Emberlight Banquet fishing rod.
2026059.comment: This volcanic rock contains rich magic and is an extremely valuable material.

2801357.name: Oceanwood
2801357.description: A type of tree that grows near the sea, standing tall and straight, like watchers gazing into the distance. The middle section can be ground down for alchemical or magical materials.
2801357.comment: A type of tree that grows near the sea, standing tall and straight, like watchers gazing into the distance. The middle section can be ground down for alchemical or magical materials.

2801358.name: Sealom Bones
2801358.description: Bones from fish that have washed ashore and buried beneath the sand. Over time, these bones turn into precious magical material.
2801358.comment: Bones from fish that have washed ashore and buried beneath the sand. Over time, these bones turn into precious magical material.

2801359.name: Running Key
2801359.description: You must pass three trials and obtain three keys to access the treasure left by the god of the waves. This is the Running Key. May one traverse the world like the wind.

2801360.name: Whitebelly Bass
2801360.description: Whitebelly bass love to dwell in shady spots. To catch one, you might need to spend an entire day under a tree.
2801360.comment: They hide among the aquatic plants and can hardly be spotted.

2801361.name: Blue Grouper
2801361.description: Blue groupers tend to lurk in between rocks and in shaded areas. If you look closely, you can see the glimmer of their dark fins in the water.

2801362.name: Yellow Shortfin
2801362.description: Yellow shortfins have a colorful appearance and firm flesh. They can only be found in deep waters.
2801362.comment: Its vibrant colors serve as camouflage.

2801363.name: Cycle Key
2801363.description: You must pass three trials and obtain three keys to access the treasure left by the god of the waves. This is the Cycle Key. May one's cycle continue perpetually like the wind.

2801364.name: Hidden Key
2801364.description: You must pass three trials and obtain three keys to access the treasure left by the god of the waves. This is the Hidden Key. May one be hidden in the wilderness like the wind.

2801369.name: Breathing Tonic
2801369.description: This potion is used to treat people who have passed out from drowning. It helps remove foreign bodies from the airways and restore breathing.
2801369.comment: Chippy urgently needs this after drowning.

2801370.name: Rusty Music Box
2801370.description: This beautiful music box still functions despite its rusty exterior. There is an inscription that reads, "May you stay happy forever, my lovely Deena."

2801371.name: Drift Bottle
2801371.description: Inside the average-sized bottle is a piece of rolled-up paper. The bottle looks like it hasn't touched the waters yet...
2801371.comment: This special letter requires an unusual mailing method.

2801372.name: Glacier Grass
2801372.description: This uncommon plant thrives in areas with ample rainfall. Its branches and leaves are slightly poisonous but have excellent anti-inflammatory properties.

2801373.name: Message in a Bottle
2801373.description: A bottle found at the beach that contains a boy's wish list.
2801373.story:
Today is the 320th day since my father and brother went to sea, and they still haven't come back.

Mother says strange things always happens at out on the ocean, and it's normal for ships to come back late, but the fog is so thick right now. The sailors at the docks say you can't see anything in it. Several ships have already crashed into the rocks or had gotten lost and never returned.

No, I can't think like that. I know my father and brother will return. They're the best sailors in all of Rustport. No matter how thick the fog is, they'll find a way. Maybe the fog is just heavier than they thought, so it's taking longer. Yeah, that must be it.

While they're gone, I have to be good and not make Mother sad. She's been sighing a lot lately. I think she's really worried as well. I need to find a way to make her happy again.

Dad told me that when Mother was younger, she loved taking care of all kinds of fish. And when he asked her to marry him, he even caught a rainbow fish out on an island to give to her! I think it was called a rainbow snapper?

If I can find a rainbow snapper and give it to Mom, I'm sure it'll make her smile.

Dad told me stories about the sea. He said that if I'm good, kind, and keep my promises, the sea will make my wishes come true.

Dear sea, <style="highlight">I wish for a beautiful rainbow snapper</style>, not to show off or cause trouble, but to make my mother happy! Please, grant my wish. I promise to always listen to my parents and never make them worry again.

<align="right">From the southern outskirts of Rustport,</align>
<align="right">A really obedient child (I promise), Almer</align>

2801378.name: Sturdy Wood
2801378.description: Sturdy, solid, and moisture-resistant—wood with these qualities is perfect for making boats.

2801379.name: Fishing Rod
2801379.description: This fishing rod is made from the trees of Blackwood Forest. It is lightweight and highly flexible.

2801380.name: Anchor Pendant
2801380.description: When Rustport was founded, the first chief hung a ship's rusty anchor on the city wall, giving it its name. Over time, the anchor became a symbol of the citizens' bravery. This pendant is awarded to those who have made exceptional contributions to the community.

2801381.name: Wild Jolly Clam
2801381.description: The locals call it the jolly clam because of the smiling face pattern on its shell. When cooked, it tastes delicious and is a popular home-cooked dish in Rustport.
2801381.comment: Be careful not to overindulge, as it can lead to uncontrollable laughter.

2801382.name: Wild Tune Sprout
2801382.description: The question mark on a tune sprout can be used to predict the weather. If the question mark is droopy, it signals an impending rain.
2801382.comment: It helps the people in Rustport to decide whether it is a good day to sail.

2801383.name: Wild Moon Snail
2801383.description: On moonlit nights, moon snails can be found on the beach or stranded in bays. They look like crescent moons from afar.

2801384.name: Wild Foxtail Grass
2801384.description: The tips of the soft grass resemble the fluffy tails of small animals. In the wilderness, people often mistakenly believe there are foxes hiding among the foxtail grass.
2801384.comment: Playing hide-and-seek in foxtail grass bushes is not allowed.

2801386.name: Sampgrass
2801386.description: Furry grass grown in the mountains with medicinal buds. Its crushed essence can stop bleeding when applied.
2801386.comment: A must-have for any explorer venturing into Rustport's wilderness.

2801387.name: Confidence Tonic
2801387.description: This tonic has a fiery color and gives a warm sensation. Just looking at it can evoke a surge of courage and confidence.
2801387.comment: As long as it can boost one's confidence, it doesn't matter if it's just a placebo.

2801388.name: Honeyberry Root
2801388.description: Craving something sweet and refreshing? This all-natural honeyberry root might be just what you need.

2801389.name: Joyous Sage
2801389.description: A spicy and warm essence can be extracted from this tropical plant.

2801390.name: Sandalwood Oil
2801390.description: This essential oil, with a rich sandalwood aroma, is a common ingredient in perfumes.

2801391.name: Premium Fish Oil
2801391.description: This premium fish oil is refined from the fat of deep-sea fish and smells like the ocean.

2801392.name: Artificial Perfume
2801392.description: Refreshing, soothing, and with a hint of wildness... This perfume fixative mimics the scent of Gray Amber perfectly!

2801393.name: "Gray Amber" Perfume
2801393.description: The artificial Gray Amber perfume is a mixture of artificial perfume and Hammie's special brew. It's just as good as the natural one!

2801394.name: Glimmerbloom Essence
2801394.description: One of the ingredients for the awakening elixir. The glimmerbloom has purified it, but it is still not completely clear and is only barely usable.
2801394.comment: There are some strange sediments at the bottom of the bottle...

2801395.name: Damedangler
2801395.description: This large-sized fish has an eerie green light on its head. Aside from special seasons when it returns to the river, it primarily lives in the ocean. It is omnivorous and has an aggressive nature, but its flesh is exceptionally delicious.
2801395.comment: How could anyone not consider this as beautiful?

2801396.name: Sturdy Wood
2801396.description: Sturdy, solid, and moisture-resistant—wood with these qualities is perfect for making boats.

2801397.name: Dirty Key
2801397.description: This brass key was removed from the stomach of a Graveborn. It appears well-preserved.

2801398.name: Small Purifier
2801398.description: Hugin made this simple purifier with fish skin, swim bladders, fish bones, and a fishing line.

2801399.name: Damedangler
2801399.description: You caught this fierce, massive fish unexpectedly while finding materials for the purifier. The fishing line and the fish bones can be used to make purifiers.

2801400.name: Moonsprat
2801400.description: When the moonlight illuminates the sea, they blend into the glimmering waves. The fish skin can be used to make purifiers.

2801401.name: Rainpearl
2801401.description: This fish is common in rivers and lakes. The swim bladders can be used to make purifiers.

2801403.name: Hammie's Special Brew
2801403.description: Hammie crafted this perfume with a touch of mysterious magical ingredients mixed with alcohol.
2801403.comment: This is a prime example of how civilians can apply magical pharmacology!

2801404.name: Jolly Clams
2801404.description: One of the ingredients for the awakening elixir. The clams are completely free of mud—possibly because the waters here are clean or the glimmerbloom has washed them.

2801405.name: Foxtail Grass
2801405.description: One of the ingredients for the awakening elixir. The plump and round fruit is perfectly ripe.

2801406.name: Awakening Elixir
2801406.description: This awakening elixir is crafted through an intricate process. According to the glimmerbloom on the island, this elixir can awaken unconscious people.

2801407.name: Old Bell
2801407.description: It remains in excellent condition despite its age, and the chime is still loud.

2801408.name: Flora's Star Map
2801408.description: This star map, hand-drawn by Flora, features all the stars in the sky.
2801408.comment: It is a shame that the color has faded slightly with time.

2801413.name: Dead Tide Cannonball
2801413.description: The Graveborns made this cannonball with whale oil, burnt fish bones, and coral ash acquired from the deep sea. It reeks of a fishy odor.
2801413.comment: The Dead Tide Fleet is better at utilizing available resources than the Water Wights.

2801414.name: Ghostfly Wings
2801414.description: When dying butterflies flap their wings for the final time, their movement can be preserved using a special solution. They can be used to make restorative elixirs.
2801414.comment: It captures the fleeting beautiful moment.

2801415.name: Elderwood Strand
2801415.description: These are the flocculent parts at the roots of ancient trees and can restore one's energy when taken alone. They can be used to make restorative elixirs.
2801415.comment: Is it true that thousand-year-old elderwood strands can speak?

2801416.name: Whisperbloom
2801416.description: These purplish flowers grow in the miasmic swamps. They are poisonous if consumed alone and must be mixed with other ingredients to be detoxified. They can be used to make restorative elixirs.

2801417.name: Flamewash
2801417.description: A potion that can extinguish gravecalling flames. Often referred to as a "key" to unlocking certain areas, it is, in fact, just a potion.

2801418.name: Nara's Ribbon
2801418.description: Nara learned her craftsmanship from Sonja. When she fell from the ship, Sonja desperately tried to pull her back but could only watch her fall. After she sank, her ribbon floated on the water's surface.

2801419.name: Island Foxtail Grass
2801419.description: A Water Wight gathered this herb from a distant island. It represents a father's profound love for his daughter.
2801419.comment: Slightly withered but still standing firm.

2801420.name: Shaded Foxtail Grass
2801420.description: Grown in areas without direct sunlight, this type of foxtail grass is more potent than the common variant. However, it has an odd smell.
2801420.comment: The fruits are smaller and more brightly colored than usual.

2801421.name: Dirty Jolly Clams
2801421.description: These jolly clams, washed ashore, are covered in mud and dirt. They need to be thoroughly cleaned before being used to make elixirs.
2801421.comment: When these clams spit out mud and dirt, it certainly isn't a jolly sight.

2801422.name: Unripe Fruit
2801422.description: The unripe fruit of tune sprouts is said to have memory-enhancing properties.

2801423.name: Hammie's Journal
2801423.description: Hammie's handwritten journal includes various magic spells and elixir recipes. Some pages have fallen off due to frequent flipping.

2801424.name: Weapon Oil
2801424.description: This oil is used to remove rust and maintain rusty metal weapons.

2801425.name: Rusted Iron Sword
2801425.description: This rust-covered iron sword looks like it hasn't been maintained in ages.

2801426.name: Polished Sword
2801426.description: This iron sword gives off a shiny glint. It looks as good as new if you overlook the scuffs and scratches on the blade.

2801427.name: Grancia
2801427.description: These flowers, gathered from a faraway country, can be used to make breathing tonics.
2801427.comment: It doesn't smell nice at all.

2801428.name: Coconfruit
2801428.description: Coconfruits from the desert look like they are breathing because of the splits on their exteriors. They can be used to make breathing tonics.
2801428.comment: It's extremely hard. Don't try breaking it with your head.

2801429.name: Longleaf Amaranth
2801429.description: This wild grass is common on the outskirts of Rustport. The juice from its crushed fruit can stop bleeding and reduce bruising.

2801430.name: Healing Potion
2801430.description: This elixir, made from longleaf amaranths, can stop bleeding, reduce bruising, promote healing, and relieve pain.

2801431.name: Red Elixir
2801431.description: This elixir looks nothing special. It tastes like sweet syrup mixed with wisteria vine juice.

2801432.name: Blue Elixir
2801432.description: This potion doesn't have a noticeable smell but has a distinctive color.
2801432.comment: Just add a few drops of blue blossom juice to the water.

2801433.name: Strange Shells
2801433.description: These beautiful shells are caught by the sea. The iridescent glow makes them look like miniature oceans.

2801434.name: Glacier Tonic
2801434.description: Glacier grass is the main ingredient of this potion. The slight amount of toxins has been neutralized, making the potion safe to consume.

2801435.name: Shiny Bottle
2801435.description: It contains a letter from Rustport, written by a little boy living in the southern suburbs named Almer.

2801437.name: Patched Net
2801437.description: This large net is patched up from torn fishing nets. It is suitable for catching small objects near the shore but not for long-term use.

2801438.name: Fish in Bottle
2801438.description: This bottle, filled with seawater, serves as a temporary home for a rainbow snapper. Chippy even thoughtfully made a few holes in the cork for airflow.

2801439.name: Beautiful Rainbow Snapper
2801439.description: Its beauty reminds one of the beautiful moments in life.

2801440.name: Stomach Elixir
2801440.description: It is said to cure almost all gastrointestinal issues, but it has a terrible smell.

2801441.name: Memory Elixir
2801441.description: A mysterious magical power flows in the swirling liquid. It is said to be an elixir that can recover one's memory.
2801441.comment: It has the same color as the ocean.

2801442.name: Water Wights Flag
2801442.description: "Water Wights never give" is a principle upheld by the Water Wights from the Stormy Strait. They display their intent to plunder through the illustrations on their flag.
2801442.comment: The Carmine Whispers are willing to buy the Water Wights' flag at a high price.

2801443.name: Bait
2801443.description: The earthworms found in the shallows of Blackwood Loch make excellent fish bait. Damedanglers love it.
2801443.comment: Actually, there is a local delicacy in Rustport...

2801447.name: Dragonflame Spire
2801447.description: This ignition device, fueled by dragon grease, can spark a flame even in the darkest of times.

2801448.name: Wanted Poster
2801448.description: An urgent bounty notice issued by the Carmine Whispers to all residents of Rustport. It has a portrait of the female Graveborn who stole the Void Relic, signed and sealed by Sonja, the leader of the Carmine Whispers.

2801450.name: Iris Root
2801450.description: Made from the carefully dried roots of irises, this has a cooling effect that relieves heat.

2801451.name: Verdunt Leaf
2801451.description: A low-growing plant that nestles in the shadows, with delicate, verdant leaves.

2801452.name: Wildgreen Treebark
2801452.description: Peeled from wildgreen trees just before autumn ends, this bark preserves the crisp, lingering chill of late autumn.

2801453.name: Anti-Fever Elixir
2801453.description: Crafted from natural herbs, this elixir has a refreshing scent that soothes the mind. Those with high fever recover instantly after consumption.
2801453.comment: Typically brewed from the roots of iris flowers, verdunt leaves, and wildgreen tree bark.

2801454.name: Cobalt Berry
2801454.description: Just as the sky begins to lighten and the morning star sings of dawn, you'll find a fruit that has bathed in the last whispers of the night's allure.

2801455.name: Violet Heartstem
2801455.description: In the heart of mist-laden swamps, where ferns weave their green enchantments, their roots exude a fragrance that lulls the weariest wanderer into a peaceful slumber.

2801456.name: Nightshade Lotus
2801456.description: In the stillness of the night, these blossoms unveil their splendor, with petals of rich purple gently parting, much like a timid beauty revealing her true allure.

2801457.name: Sleeping Elixir
2801457.description: Steeped in the mysteries of the night, this elixir's calming scent can settle the most restless minds. It grants swift, dreamless sleep, coveted by nobles who willingly pay great sums of gold for just a small flask.

2801458.name: Gold Coins
2801458.description: Glinting in the sunlight, gold coins lie scattered on the path, luring every passerby with their irresistible sparkle.
2801458.comment: If you don't want them, I'm picking them up!

2801459.name: Timber
2801459.description: Used in crafting a wall-repairing concoction.

2801460.name: Mud
2801460.description: Used in crafting a wall-repairing concoction.

2801461.name: Wall Plaster
2801461.description: An aromatic concoction that emits a pungent scent, expertly blended from wood and mud. Can be used to repair damaged walls.

2801462.name: Featherbug
2801462.description: These unhatched butterflies, dried to a brittle state, carries medicinal properties.

2801463.name: Wingleaf
2801463.description: Found clinging to cliff sides and rocky slopes, its leaves are etched with wing-like patterns.

2801464.name: Healing Potion
2801464.description: A sweet-smelling potion that is used to alleviate minor ailments.
2801464.comment: Simmered with featherbugs, wildgreen treebark, and wingleaves.

2801465.name: Gruntgrass
2801465.description: A type of weed that grows lushly along riverbanks, it's a favorite among pigs.

2801466.name: Leafmary
2801466.description: Slender and sweet, these green blades can be added into recipes.

2801467.name: Insect Meat
2801467.description: Crushed insect meat oozing with translucent liquid.

2801468.name: Pig Feed
2801468.description: A scrumptious blend favored by piglets.

2801475.name: About Fish King
2801475.story:
Only a fishing expert can catch the legendary fish king—<style="highlight">golden peacock</style>!
Below is the information about the golden peacock:
It is a species unique to <style="highlight">Rustport</style>.
It might appear <style="highlight">at dusk and during the night</style>.
It is said to feed on gold.

2801480.name: Fire Brew
2801480.description: With a taste as fierce as a dragon's breath, this fiery spice blazes through your throat. It serves as a potent foundation for crafting an array of brews and spirited concoctions.

2801481.name: Egg White
2801481.description: These normal egg whites are used for making brews and mixed drinks, or if you're trying to bulk up and need that protein.

2801482.name: Guava Juice
2801482.description: Guava juice is often used in brews and mixtures. Who doesn't like guava smoothies?

2801483.name: Honey Syrup
2801483.description: The prized honey syrup of hornleaf bears is very sweet and is used to enhance the flavor of drinks, pastries, and virtually any edible item.

2801484.name: Bols' Special Brew
2801484.description: A special brew prepared with Bols' secret recipe. It has a unique and unforgettable aftertaste. Don't be surprised if you grow hair where you don't expect.

2801485.name: Splitpod
2801485.description: When a splitpod reaches its peak ripeness, it cracks apart, unleashing a rich, oily fragrance.

2801486.name: Swallow Feather
2801486.description: A feather of young swallow coated with sea salt and left out to dry.

2801487.name: Spirit Root
2801487.description: Hidden within the lush undergrowth, this elusive tree root emits a unique scent, captivating gophers who seek out its mysterious fragrance.

2801488.name: Strong Healing Potion
2801488.description: This red elixir has a slightly bitter scent and can help restore energy. It is commonly used for treating post-battle wounds and is a must-have for travelers.

2801489.name: Perlite
2801489.description: A harmonious union of mussels and rocks, adorned with tiny, shimmering crystals that glisten like stardust upon the surface.

2801490.name: Froststone
2801490.description: Born of freezing winds, this crystal shimmers with a gentle light, its surface perpetually cold to the touch, like a shard of pure frost.

2801491.name: Waterstone
2801491.description: Born from the embrace of flowing waters, this crystal radiates a luminous glow and feels soothingly cool, like the first touch of dawn's dew.

2801492.name: Fireproof Coating
2801492.description:
This coating has speckles that resemble crystal dust exhaled by a ferocious beast from a frosty land.
It can be applied to any surface to insulate against heat transfer.
2801492.comment: It is generally made from 3 grams of perlite, 10 grams of waterstone, and a big piece of froststone.

2801493.name: Bittergreen Twig
2801493.description: The sprout harvested from the bittergreen tree exudes a slightly bitter sap when soaked.

3801469.name: Icewreath Pine
3801469.description: A rare species of pine native to the coldest regions. Its rings hold secrets of the harshest winters.

3801470.name: Frost Crystal
3801470.description: Remnants of ice elementals that have dispersed, much colder than mere ice.
3801470.comment: Don't be tempted to lick it!

3801471.name: Boil-O-Scope
3801471.description: Invented by Hugin to detect temperature shifts with precision. Essential for discovering hidden hot springs for the Frozen Paw.
3801471.comment: Worth much more than the net profit!

3801472.name: Portrait Piece 1
3801472.description: This is a piece of an old portrait that was torn out by someone.
3801472.comment: A face radiating happiness, yet with an undecipherable expression.

3801473.name: Portrait Piece 2
3801473.description: This is a piece of an old portrait that was torn out by someone.
3801473.comment: The rose is beautiful but covered with dust.

3801474.name: Portrait Piece 3
3801474.description: This is a piece of an old portrait that was torn out by someone.
3801474.comment: A gaping void remained where my heart once was.

3801494.name: Misted Beanberry
3801494.description: A commonly used seasoning used at the Frozen Paw. Crush and sprinkle it on dishes to elevate their flavor.

3801495.name: Sapphirine Blossom
3801495.description: The best gift to present to Dura during prayer is a bouquet of fully bloomed sapphirine blossoms.

3801496.name: Lost Hat
3801496.description: This hat that fell in the snow looks like it belongs to Natasha.
3801496.comment: Gosh, it's warm! I could hibernate in here!

3801497.name: Frostberry
3801497.description: These frost-covered berries are sweet and tangy, and the people of Cedartown often use them to make fruit salads.

3801498.name: Frozen Honeyfruit
3801498.description: Able to grow in cold environments, this type of honeyfruit hides sweet, ice cream-like pulp under the skin. It's a popular choice for salads in Cedartown.
3801498.comment: A delicacy that can only be eaten in winter.

3801499.name: Frozen Fruit Salad
3801499.description: A simple yet cherished specialty of Cedartown, offered to Dura in the harshest of winters as a symbol of devotion.

3801500.name: Unripe Firethorn Fruit
3801500.description: The firethorn fruit still has a slight green tinge and is not fully ripe. It can be used to make potions, elixirs, and salves.

3801501.name: Riverbank Spiritroot
3801501.description: These roots grow near rivers and gather more magic than common spiritroots. They can be used to make potions, elixirs, and salves.

3801502.name: Small Frostpearl
3801502.description: Being so tiny, you might overlook it on the hook if you're not careful. It can be used to make potions, elixirs, and salves.
3801502.comment: It has the same color as ice.

3801503.name: Blessing Elixir
3801503.description: A blessing elixir crafted following the temple's recipe. When applied at the right time, it makes the person feel the touch of divine power.
3801503.comment: Blessed art thou who comes in the name of the divine.

3801504.name: Rusty Medal
3801504.description: The old medal retrieved from the undead warrior was so thickly coated with rust that the original design was completely obscured.
3801504.comment: A coat of rust marks the history of time and serves as proof of forgotten moments.

3801505.name: Aged Amulet
3801505.description: The talisman worn by the undead warrior has lost its original shine, yet the engraved line of small words remains clear, as if it has been frequently wiped clean.

3801506.name: Flower Vase
3801506.description: A vase of dainty roses found in the dimly dark house, imbuing it with an unusual allure.

3801507.name: Flower Vase
3801507.description: A vase of dainty roses found in the dimly dark house, imbuing it with an unusual allure.

3801508.name: Blue Spiritroot
3801508.description: A unique mutant plant from which expensive pigments are derived by grinding the roots and repeatedly extracting the collected sap.

3801509.name: Unripe Crystalberries
3801509.description: A key ingredient for anti-allergy medicine, with a sour and tart flavor.

3801510.name: Fleshy Lampfish
3801510.description: An exceptionally plump lampfish. Its fat is an excellent material for making ignis cores.

3801511.name: Snow Wolf Tail Hair
3801511.description: The thick, silver-gray tail fur of the snow wolf is flammable and burn-resistant. The hairs are hollow yet tough, making them great for ignis cores.

3801512.name: Ignis Core
3801512.description: It's used in the lighting ceremony of the Snowspire Festival. With it, the hero sculpture can be lit up with an "Eternal Flame".
3801512.comment: Lighting fires on ice sculptures... Which mad genius came up with this thing?

3801513.name: 7-Petal Sapphirine
3801513.description: Rare and elusive, the 7-petal sapphirine blossom is regarded as a sign of 'miracles' in the Duchy of Whiteridge.
3801513.comment: Sacredness, valor, kindness, devotion, sacrifice, tenacity, and miracles.

3801514.name: Valesa Castle Map
3801514.description: A map from Ludovic's collection detailing the castle's interior. The castle has remained largely unchanged for centuries, making this map perfect for finding your way.

3801515.name: Fresh Firethorn Fruit
3801515.description: A fresh large firethorn fruit. It's surprising that this medicinal plant is also used to craft ignis cores.

3801516.name: Amberfruits
3801516.description: This sweet, clear yellow fruit is delicious but usually grows in dangerous, wild places. Dominique has long wanted to give it to his mother as a birthday gift.
3801516.comment: A taste of nostalgia, a taste of the past.

3801532.name: Snowgem Berry
3801532.description: Rich in fat, these berries are essential for crafting lubricant.

3801533.name: Firethorn Fruit
3801533.description: Bright red berries stand out like jewels across snow-covered mountains. They can be used to make lubricant.

3801534.name: Bird Saliva
3801534.description: An unique component in it is essential for making lubricant.

3801535.name: Lubricant
3801535.description: A lubricant extracted through high-temperature processing.
3801535.comment: Be careful not to let it slip out of your hands!

3801536.name: Paw Herring
3801536.description: The hot spring and seasoning bring out the balm herring's flavor, and the flesh has a melt-in-your-mouth texture.
3801536.comment: The Frozen Paw's new signature dish.

3801538.name: Durable Wood
3801538.description: This is from a tree planted by Ludovic himself from when he was alive. The passage of years has rendered it quite hard.

3801539.name: Radinov Ring
3801539.description: Set with radiant rubies, this ring bears the family crest of the Radinov lineage.

3801540.name: Decayed Letter
3801540.description: A timeworn letter with fading ink, still legible enough for Carolina to recognize the handwriting.
3801540.comment: You feel brotherly love emanating from this.

3801541.name: Hard Pine Wood
3801541.description: A type of wood that is extremely hard, moisture-resistant, and rot-proof, making it the most affordable material for coffins.

3801542.name: Anti-Allergy Potion
3801542.description: A special anti-allergy potion that can offer swift relief for Gali, though its effect is short-lived.
3801542.comment: It really doesn't taste as good as it looks!

3801543.name: Dried Snowradish
3801543.description: A vital-component for crafting anti-allergy medicine, thanks to its low moisture content.

3801544.name: Energizing Herb
3801544.description: This unripe snowradish packs a punch. Its root delivers a cool, sour, and spicy sensation that's sure you leave you invigorated.
3801544.comment: Take a bite for a fiery, refreshing kick that's sure to jolt your senses awake.

3801545.name: Levski's Painting
3801545.description: This is Levski's final painting before falling ill. Ludovic's restoration has made the original colors and brushstrokes more vivid.

3801546.name: Special Flower Tea
3801546.description: Flower tea brewed according to Mister Teapot's exclusive recipe. Normally, the flavor shouldn't be only bitter.

3801547.name: Beautiful Painting
3801547.description: The oil painting drawn by Princess Yolena herself depicts the wonderful time you spent together at the Snowspire Festival.
3801547.comment: Be forever happy, my dear friends! — Yolena Valesa

3801548.name: Archduke's Emblem
3801548.description: The emblem of the Archduke of Whiteridge, Sigmund Valesa. Typically bestowed only to his trusted confidants, it grants the bearer unrestricted access to Valesa Castle.
3801548.comment: With this item in your possession, you can go anywhere in the castle. Even the bedchamber of that handsome court mage.

3801549.name: Painting Piece
3801549.description: A piece of painting that shows a man's hand with a ring that can be vaguely seen.

3801550.name: Hot Ginger Tea
3801550.description: Luminite Mine miners' drink of choice. Just a sip will warm you right up!
3801550.comment: Drink it hot and feel toasty on the inside!

3801551.name: Greater Healing Potion
3801551.description: A powerful healing potion, refined from common healing potions, boasts excellent effects on most injuries. Strict adherence to the dosage is crucial, as improper use can turn it lethal.
3801551.comment: Just the right amount, and you're fully healed. One more drop, and you're as dead as a dwarf without his hammer and tools.

3801552.name: Rusty Longsword
3801552.description: The blade's former glory is devoured by rust, its origins lost to time. It stands as a testament to the valiant warriors who fought in an age now forgotten.
3801552.comment: Not all heroes find their names etched in history.

3801553.name: Wild Crystalberry
3801553.description: Crystalberries thrive in cold weather. The colder it gets, the sweeter the fruit becomes. In Whiteridge, they're a specialty often used to make wine or jam.
3801553.comment: If you've never tasted crystalberries, then you haven't truly experienced Whiteridge! Seek them out in the world.

3801554.name: Wild Snowgem Berry
3801554.description: Sour snowgem berries are typically used as a tart enhancer in desserts. However, when harvested after the frost, the fruit turns crystal clear and has a delightful sweet and sour flavor.
3801554.comment: What do they taste like? Just take a bite... Ouch, my teeth! Go find them in the world.

3801555.name: Wild Snowradish
3801555.description: These root vegetables thrive in cold regions. They are crisp, sweet, and possess medicinal value.
3801555.comment: Can be used for a snowman's nose. Seek them out in the world.

3801556.name: Wild Firethorn Fruit
3801556.description: A medicinal plant used to stop bleeding. Some have cut their fingers on its leaves, while many more have been poisoned by its fruits.
3801556.comment: No matter how beautiful it is, this cannot be eaten. I said NO!

3801557.name: Wild Spiritroot
3801557.description: Some claim that consuming spiritroot allows communication with the dead, but in truth, it will lead to your own demise.
3801557.comment: Desperate to talk to the departed? Fine, eat it... Look for it out in the world, but don't say I didn't warn you...

3801558.name: Wild Sapphirine Blossom
3801558.description: It is the ducal flower of the Duchy of Whiteridge. Its six petals represent the virtues of sacredness, valor, kindness, devotion, sacrifice, and tenacity.
3801558.comment: Can be used at weddings and funerals. Search for it in the world.

3801559.name: 7-Petal Sapphirine
3801559.description: Rare and elusive, the 7-petal sapphirine blossom is regarded as a sign of 'miracles' in the Duchy of Whiteridge.
3801559.comment: Sacredness, valor, kindness, devotion, sacrifice, tenacity, and miracles.

3801560.name: Crystalberry
3801560.description: Sweet in taste with pain-relieving properties, often used to make pain medicine for children.

3801561.name: Snowradish
3801561.description: This rare radish can halt even the worst bleeding.

3801562.name: Hemostatic Potion
3801562.description: A simple decoction prepared to treat Sasha's wounds.

3801563.name: Art Fragment 1
3801563.description: A torn piece of an oil painting, capturing a bouquet of roses.

3801564.name: Art Fragment 2
3801564.description: A scrap of a painting showing someone writing a letter.
3801564.comment: Weird, how can this be pieced back together?

3801565.name: Art Fragment 3
3801565.description: A chilling fragment depicting the gleam of a dagger.
3801565.comment: Perhaps reality is more terrifying than art.

3801566.name: Fresh Crystalberries
3801566.description: A delicious berry native to cold regions. With a flavor like honey, they're a favorite treat of hornleaf bears.

3801567.name: Woolen Scarf
3801567.description: A scarf woven from sheep's wool, a guardian against the cold.

3801568.name: Luminite
3801568.description: Ice crystal shards of varying sizesa nd shapes. Each shard hums a unique tone when struck.

3801569.name: The Mage and the Adventurer
3801569.description: "The Mage and the Adventurer"—A timeless storybook discovered in the forgotten corners of Everstill Manor.

3801571.name: Fresh Reed Trout
3801571.description: They tend to hide in small groups among the corals, and you can frequently spot their eggs here.

3801572.name: Fresh Balm Herring
3801572.description: It gives off a distinct scent. When refined and diluted, its fish oil is perfect for perfume, but the supply is extremely limited.

3801573.name: Fresh Icy Catfish
3801573.description: This fish is abundant in icy waters, larger than the catfish found in warmer regions, and is said to be extra crispy when fried.

3801574.name: Fresh Bubba Shrimp
3801574.description: A delicacy from icy waters, it's best served raw—skip it, and you'll regret it.

3801575.name: Getaway Key
3801575.description: The ultimate objective for all participants in the Ghostly Getaway activity.
3801575.comment: Will you unlock the way out, or will this place's secrets trap you forever?

3801576.name: Sapphirine Bouquet
3801576.description: The national flower of Whiteridge. These add timeless grace to any setting.

3801577.name: Winter's Kiss
3801577.description: A local spirit from Whiteridge. It starts cold but finishes hot. Each sip is a kiss from the winter itself.
3801577.comment: Even the fish of Whiteridge know its taste.

3801578.name: Frosty Meat
3801578.description: Sergey's signature cured meat, made from his secret recipe.
3801578.comment: Not entirely sure if it's edible.

3801579.name: Meat Bait
3801579.description: A fish bait made of strong liquor and cured meat, emitting a rich boozy aroma.
3801579.comment: Do Whiteridge fish really go for this stuff?

3801580.name: A pile of building materials.
3801580.description: The raw materials for building houses.
3801580.comment: You can shape and polish it according to your needs.

3801581.name: Spiritroot
3801581.description: This unique plant has a vast root system.
3801581.comment: It looks so ready for a sprint.

3801582.name: Snowgem Berry
3801582.description: These golden fruits can be found in abundance in Whiteridge.
3801582.comment: Tasty treats you can enjoy from the bushes.

3801583.name: Snowgem Berry
3801583.description: These golden fruits can be found in abundance in Whiteridge.
3801583.comment: Tasty treats you can enjoy from the bushes.

3801584.name: Radish
3801584.description: Radishes, a common crop in snowy areas, are known for their crisp and refreshing taste.
3801584.comment: Inch by inch, row by row, gonna make these radishes grow...

3801586.name: Paint
3801586.description: This paint is made from plant extracts and carries a sweet, fruity fragrance.
3801586.comment: Use it to make picture frames look as shiny as new.

3801587.name: Delicious Dinner
3801587.description: A simple dinner whipped up from ingredients gathered from the snow.
3801587.comment: It has a distinctive scent of nature.

3801595.name: Citizen's Pack
3801595.description: This backpack reeks of a foul odor, likely from spoiled food that its owner stored in it.

3801596.name: Radish
3801596.description: Radishes, a common crop in snowy areas, are known for their crisp and refreshing taste.
3801596.comment: Inch by inch, row by row, gonna make these radishes grow...

3801597.name: Spiritroot
3801597.description: This unique plant has a vast root system.
3801597.comment: It looks so ready for a sprint.

3801598.name: Nourishing Soup
3801598.description: Each spoonful of the hearty soup takes you down memory lane.

3801604.name: Iceberry
3801604.description: This small, crystal-like fruit only appears after the frost.
3801604.comment: Rumor has it that not even the fiercest fire can destroy it.

3801605.name: Crystal Branch
3801605.description: The leaves, often covered with a layer of frost, exude purity.

3801606.name: Frost Oil
3801606.description: This blessed ointment ensures the caskets remain frozen.
3801606.comment: It is extremely cold. Be sure to wear gloves before touching it.

3801607.name: Stormflower
3801607.description: Nourished by rainwater, this plant can be used to concoct growth potions for plants.
3801607.comment: It blooms and bears fruit at the same time.

3801608.name: Ivywood Branch
3801608.description: Legend has it that these colorful fruits possess different effects.

3801609.name: Growth Potion
3801609.description: Made according to the recipe found in the passage, this potion can promote plant growth.

3801610.name: Decoration Box
3801610.description: It holds an assortment of delicate and exquisite decorations for adorning doughmen.
3801610.comment: It has everything you could ever need.

3801611.name: Festive Painting
3801611.description: This painting is Princess Yolena's favorite. It depicts the masquerade of the Snowspire Festival.
3801611.comment: The joy of the festival is eternalized in the painting.

3801612.name: Yolena's Flower
3801612.description: Princess Yolena personally tended to this plant during her lifetime. It grows beautifully, with white blossoms.
3801612.comment: It thrives even without anyone tending to it.

3801613.name: Floral Wreath
3801613.description: This floral wreath can be seen everywhere during the festival, adding to the joyous atmosphere.

3801614.name: Ice Block
3801614.description: The material used to make caskets.

3801615.name: Cold Oil
3801615.description: The material used to make the base of frost oil.

3801616.name: Hemostatic Elixir
3801616.description: This elixir, prepared on the spot, can effectively stop bleeding.
3801616.comment: This is designed specifically for wounds caused by the undead.

3801617.name: Man's Backpack
3801617.description: This travel backpack, stuffed with items, is worn but clean.
3801617.comment: This backpack contains the man's belongings.

3801618.name: Everbloom Bouquet
3801618.description: These blue flowers, thriving in the soil of the graveyard, represent the deceased's final yearning for the mortal world.
3801618.comment: Life is an arduous journey speckled with memorable moments.

3801659.name: Rocking Horse
3801659.description: A simple but well-crafted wooden rocking horse, made under expert guidance. Ordinary as it is, it carries the love of two parents.

4801537.name: Mature Mushroom
4801537.description: This common mushroom species has a soft texture and tastes even better when dried. The mature variety is known for its pain-relieving properties.

4801585.name: Dwarven Greatsword
4801585.description: This two-handed greatsword is swiftly forged using the production line of Brimstone Village.
4801585.comment: It is sharp and powerful despite its lightness.

4801591.name: Etching Iris
4801591.description: This plant flaunts vivid, highly toxic blooms that exude a bold and striking fragrance. Only its roots are harmless.

4801592.name: Coconut Oil
4801592.description: This golden, smooth essence is extracted from the core of coconuts. It releases a delicate fragrance with a gentle swirl and acts as an excellent medium for blending various ingredients.

4801593.name: Honey Amber
4801593.description: Its bright and translucent hue gives it an amber-like appearance. When melted, it has an incredibly smooth texture.

4801594.name: Mystic Dew
4801594.description: This fragrant liquid, known as Mystic Dew, is prepared according to a secret recipe. It is highly sought after among the Essail nobles, and its uses remain a mystery.

4801600.name: Statue Pieces
4801600.description: These pieces from Queen Seralyth's statue are imbued with disturbing dark magic. Whoever possesses them may suffer from hallucinations.

4801601.name: Refined Ore
4801601.description: Through forging and magical enhancement by the dwarves, this ore gains resistance to magic while retaining its toughness.

4801603.name: Skyflower
4801603.description: When crushed, these petals release a striking blue juice that is often used as paint.

4801619.name: Etching Iris
4801619.description: This annual herbaceous plant has highly toxic, acidic flowers. It is often used by mages to craft special potions.
4801619.comment: One of the ingredients used to make the removal agent.

4801620.name: Moon Orchid Dew
4801620.description: This dew forms on moon orchid petals, its silver-blue color glowing in the dark. It must be stored in enchanted vials to preserve its magical energy.
4801620.comment: One of the ingredients used to make the removal agent.

4801621.name: Removal Agent
4801621.description: This potion breaks down plant fibers with minimal effect on other substances. To use, simply apply it to the surface of the target.
4801621.comment: The special removal agent for the viney door.

4801623.name: Dreambloom Seed
4801623.description: These seeds belong to a type of bioluminescent mushroom unique to Sal'thorin. Plant them in your bedroom to enjoy a night filled with sweet dreams.
4801623.comment: May the stars be your companions in your dreams.

4801624.name: Candy Box
4801624.description: The honey candies inside are a beloved treat in Sal'thorin, each wrapped in silver foil and accompanied by a handwritten wish from Feli.

4801625.name: Magic Bottle
4801625.description: This magic bottle contains unique spores. When the spores gather and begin to glow, simply open the bottle for a gentle spore shower.
4801625.comment: Shake it for a spore shower!

4801626.name: Wife's Letter
4801626.story:
Dear Harge,
I haven't heard from you in a while, so I suppose you are going through a rough patch. It must be hard being away from home, facing everything on your own, but you never complain. I know it's because you don't want us to worry...

If you're exhausted, just come home! Tali and I miss you a lot. For us, the moments we share as a family are far more precious than any wealth.

<align="right">Waiting for you with love,
<align="right">Freda and Tali

4801628.name: Baby Mushroom
4801628.description: Though small and inconspicuous, it grows astonishingly fast and has remarkable adaptability.
4801628.comment: Too small to eat, but perfect as a potion ingredient.

4801629.name: Dashroot Powder
4801629.description: This pale green powder, ground from dashroot, is an essential ingredient in quickgrow potions.
4801629.comment: It seems darker than it is supposed to be...

4801630.name: Sturdy Dashroot
4801630.description: This herbaceous plant grows rapidly and has extensive roots that can penetrate even the hardest soil for nutrients. It is an essential ingredient in quickgrow potions.
4801630.comment: Not recommended for anyone who still wishes to grow taller!

4801631.name: Quickgrow Potion
4801631.description: This potion appears noticeably darker than its usual color.

4801632.name: Quickgrow Potion
4801632.description: Just a drop of this green potion can bring a forest to life.

4801633.name: Stele Inscription
4801633.story:
The gods have blessed our kind!
Our hammers strike, without respite!
Our furnace burns, a constant glow!

In honor of Helthor, we held a ceremony here.
We offered our treasured items, our hearts sincere.

Burning liquid flows with fiery grace, forging crystals in their place. Magic washes away the dirt, the secret of craftsmanship is overt!

Our heirs of tomorrow, guard this legacy well. The dwarven art shall in ages dwell. Though monuments crumble and fade, the artistry of dwarves shall never degrade!

4801634.name: Lava
4801634.description: Used in forging by the dwarves, it forms the bedrock of their ancient civilization.

4801635.name: Sturdy Ore
4801635.description: The dwarves once hammered and cherished this ore. Time has left not a single mark on its surface.

4801636.name: Old Journal (II)
4801636.story:
...Who led us astray? Helthor? Or ourselves?...
...We justified ourselves... Our passion for craftsmanship drove us to stop at nothing...
