...At what point... my passion turned into greed, making me forget who I truly was...
...I've been abandoning my creations one by one... until I saw my very first work...
...my most cherished work... from beneath the stele...
...I remember the joy of forging my first creation... the true spirit of a craftsman...
...But I can't even take it with me...

4801637.name: Pure Iron
4801637.description: This high-quality pure iron is the result of a meticulous process. Its gleam reflects the wisdom of its maker.

4801638.name: Harmless Fuzzy Mushrooms
4801638.description: A common mushroom with a soft texture. It becomes even more flavorful when dried.

4801639.name: Fresh Stream Starlitfish
4801639.description: They love to swim together in shallow streams, and their flesh is tender and delicious.

4801640.name: Purified Water
4801640.description: This special spring water can be used directly for brewing. However, to craft a premium brew, it must be purified before use.

4801641.name: Crystal Salt
4801641.description: This salt, carefully scraped from the crystal pillars, carries a unique flavor. It's more suitable for brewing than everyday cooking.

4801643.name: Glowing Spore
4801643.description: These glowing spores from the underground mushroom jungle are often used by the Essail for decoration.

4801644.name: Gem Brooch
4801644.description: This stunningly intricate brooch appears to be made from special materials.

4801645.name: Fresh Tetra Fish
4801645.description: The fish, as light as a bubble, compensates for its blindness with its heightened vigilance.

4801646.name: Memory Flower
4801646.description: These magical pink flowers emit a silvery glow from their edges and reveal fragments of past memories when infused with magic.

4801647.name: Dwarven Rune I
4801647.description: The inscription on this ancient dwarven runestone translates to "one".
4801647.comment: It seems capable of unlocking special mechanisms.

4801648.name: Dwarven Rune II
4801648.description: The inscription on this ancient dwarven runestone translates to "two".
4801648.comment: It seems capable of unlocking special mechanisms.

4801649.name: Dwarven Rune III
4801649.description: The inscription on this ancient dwarven runestone translates to "three".
4801649.comment: It seems capable of unlocking special mechanisms.

4801650.name: Dwarven Rune IV
4801650.description: The inscription on this ancient dwarven runestone translates to "four".
4801650.comment: It seems capable of unlocking special mechanisms.

4801651.name: Vibrant Mushroom
4801651.description: The vivid spores on the surface are resistant to fading. If only it could be used as paint...

4801652.name: Ancient Key
4801652.description: This ancient key, crafted in a distinct dwarven style, has been hidden for an unknown amount of time.

4801653.name: Nightshards
4801653.description: When burned, this strange chimera releases smoke that attaches to fabric, giving it an air of mystery.

4801654.name: Flamefern Leaves
4801654.description: These bright red, scale-like leaves emit a rich and sweet fruity fragrance. Sadly, most people only notice the luscious berries they hold.
4801654.comment: What flavor would the brew take on if this were added?

4801655.name: Spider Silk
4801655.description: The silk from spiders is fine yet extremely resilient.

4801656.name: Tailoring Tools
4801656.description: A dwarf craftsman forged this tool with great care. It is said to help its user stay focused and patient.

4801657.name: Merlin's Brew
4801657.description: This pale golden liquid exudes a robust aroma, forming rich, velvety foam when gently swirled. Its flavor, however, remains a mystery.

4801658.name: Pure Divine Dew
4801658.description: The liquid is almost as clear as water, with only the faintest hint of gold. It has probably been diluted.
4801658.comment: Like a mix of water with just a few drops of Divine Dew.

4801660.name: Natural Nightshard
4801660.description: A bizarre chimera of nature—part flora, part stone. Occasionally emits puffs of smoke.
4801660.comment: Anyone brave enough to try it?

4801661.name: Wild Flamefern
4801661.description: A fiery-leaved plant with scale-like foliage. Its sweet fruit drops when ripe and is often made into jam.
4801661.comment: Maybe it can be used to start a fire?

4801662.name: Natural Celestrite
4801662.description: Buried deep within the rocky layers, this mineral gleams with an enchanting icy-blue glow.
4801662.comment: Ranked just below gold in the hearts of dwarves.

4801663.name: Wild Etching Iris
4801663.description: Beautiful but deadly—every part of this plant poisons except the spicy rhizome, prized for its spicy flavor and commonly used as a seasoning.
4801663.comment: Remember which parts are edible! One wrong bite and you're toast.

4801664.name: Wild Fuzzy Mushroom
4801664.description: Plush and savory when dried, but excess consumption may induce illusions.
4801664.comment: It's fuzzy, it's flavorful, and it's full of surprises.

4801665.name: Elea's Ring
4801665.description: This ring, belonging to Elsa, is one of a pair. It is said to hold ancient magic and blessings.
4801665.comment: Is it a blessing or a curse? Or perhaps, it is just a symbol of longing...

4801672.name: Soaked Journal
4801672.description: This soaked journal contains crayon sketches of people, plants, and animals that are clearly drawn by a child. Maybe it could bring comfort to a tearful little one.

4801673.name: Helthor's Hymn 1
4801673.description: This is part of a hymn for Helthor. Why not gather the remaining parts and offer them to the <style="highlight">dwarves who enjoy chanting Helthor's hymns</style>?

4801674.name: Helthor's Hymn 2
4801674.description: This is part of a hymn for Helthor. Why not gather the remaining parts and offer them to the <style="highlight">dwarves who enjoy chanting Helthor's hymns</style>?

4801675.name: Helthor's Hymn 3
4801675.description: This is part of a hymn for Helthor. Why not gather the remaining parts and offer them to the <style="highlight">dwarves who enjoy chanting Helthor's hymns</style>?

4801676.name: Love Letter (1)
4801676.description: One of the discarded love letter drafts written by a maid for Ravion, its quivering handwriting betraying her nervousness. Gather all the drafts and <style="highlight">return</style> them to the <style="highlight">flustered maid</style>.

4801677.name: Love Letter (2)
4801677.description: The maid's second love letter draft for Ravion, with the handwriting appearing more steady this time. Gather all the drafts and <style="highlight">return</style> them to the <style="highlight">flustered maid</style>.

4801678.name: Love Letter (3)
4801678.description: The maid's third love letter draft for Ravion. The handwriting is neat, but the bottom of the page is marked with tear stains. Gather all the drafts and <style="highlight">return</style> them to the <style="highlight">flustered maid</style>.

4801680.name: Peculiar Fish Bone
4801680.description: This peculiar fishbone is the little sith's favorite toy. It enjoys using the fishbone to lure its companions, and then watch them scatter in frantic escape.

4801681.name: Lost Letter
4801681.description: This unsent letter is written by <style="highlight">Ansiel</style> to <style="highlight">Ashlee</style>, who lives in the <style="highlight">commoners' district</style>.

4801682.name: Society Insider
4801682.description: This cheap tabloid is filled with noble gossip. It might hold a special significance to <style="highlight">Viscount Erikk</style>, the subject of the headline.

4801683.name: Grilled Ironfin Trout
4801683.description: The ironfin trout, grilled on the searing ground, gives off an irresistible aroma. Its tiny size makes it perfect for hamsters.

4801684.name: Mech Engineering Primer v1.04
4801684.description: The pages of this beginner's textbook on mechanics are yellowed, with edges curled from frequent flipping. You seem to have seen something similar in <style="highlight">Brimstone Village</style>.

4801685.name: Exquisite Locket
4801685.description: The noblewoman is clearly troubled by what lies inside this exquisite locket, which belongs to a young man of humble origins.

4801686.name: Open Locket
4801686.description: The locket holds a portrait of Indris. Does it symbolize the owner's lofty ambitions or a fervent obsession?

4801687.name: Pickaxe
4801687.description: This mining pickaxe, though ordinary in design, is sturdy and durable. Give it to a miner, and it may unleash its full potential.

4801693.name: A Better Future!
4801693.story:
My fellow comrades and friends!
We're young, determined, and driven! We're the hope of the dwarves, and it's up to us to shape a bright future!
Let's strive for a glorious tomorrow, with our hammers and anvils in hand!

4801694.name: The Great Research
4801694.story:
This research project is the path forward!

To revive the ancient kingdom, we must cast aside the corrupted production lines and pick up our hammers and anvils once more! With our skill and passion, we can forge the most perfect creation!

Against this backdrop, securing the ancient blueprint is a crucial step in realizing our plan.

Legend has it that our ancestors once forged extraordinary weapons from rare materials, all overseen by Helthor himself. Our mission now is to study the blueprints and recreate these weapons!

The project... begins now!

4801696.name: Reeled In
4801696.story:
Attention, Anglers!
Whether you're a novice, intermediate, or master fisherman, we know you're all eager to catch <style="highlight">rockguana</style>, the legendary Fish King.
But beware! If anyone claims:
"Only MY fishing ponds attract rockguana!"
"You NEED my special lure to catch rockguana!"
"You need to pay a fee for 'rockguana rights'!"
DO NOT buy it! These are SCAMS. Walk away—don't let them fish for your wallet!
Pro Tips for Catching Rockguanas (Totally Free!):
Rockguanas love metal, so your best bet is fishing in lava lake areas near <style="highlight">Ember Mines</style>. They tend to be most active around <style="highlight">noon</style>, so that's when you'll want to cast your line!
If you run into any scammers, please report them to the guards. Let's keep fishing honest!

4801697.name: Red Shrimp Bait
4801697.description: An expensive, pungent bait said to be a favorite of the rockguana, the Fish King.

4801698.name: Metal Gear
4801698.description: A heavy, rusted gear discarded by dwarves. Barely catches the eye.

4801701.name: Dwarven Greatsword
4801701.description: This two-handed greatsword is forged with enchanted celestrite. The blade is sharp and sturdy.

4801702.name: Slimy Rainwraith
4801702.description: This fish, with unusually slippery skin, is often spotted when it rains.

4801703.name: Slimy Prism Trout
4801703.description: This colorful fish has shiny scales covered by a layer of transparent oil.

4801704.name: Hexaflower
4801704.description: The most common seasoning in the land. It is sweet and can be eaten directly, or it can be dried and ground into a seasoning powder.

4801705.name: Glowfly Fruit
4801705.description: This fruit has thin, translucent skin and sweet, delicious flesh.

4801706.name: Fresh Woozy Loverfish
4801706.description: Nothing can separate this pair of fish.

4801707.name: Hard Nightshard
4801707.description: A bizarre chimera of nature—part flora, part stone. Occasionally emits puffs of smoke.

4801708.name: Dull Arcane Steel
4801708.description: This dull arcane steel is made from enchanted nightshard. Its properties are unknown.

4801709.name: Glowfly Fruit
4801709.description: This juicy glowfly fruit has a sweet fragrance that attracts small animals.

4801710.name: Nocturnal Whisper
4801710.story:
<style="highlight">Ravion's Special Drink: Nocturnal Whisper</style>
The purified <style="highlight">darkspring water</style> captures the elegance of the night, while the <style="highlight">crystal salt</style> not only adds a refreshing touch but also shimmers like twinkling stars.
Now, pour in the <style="highlight">secret brew</style> and blend it with finesse...

Voila, it's done! Go ahead and admire its mesmerizing beauty in the dark.
Give the glass a gentle swirl, and the shimmer within will captivate you long before the first sip ever touches your lips.
The mellow sweetness and refreshing touch will leave you wanting more.
But don't let the pleasant flavor fool you—it will knock you out before you even realize it!

4801716.name: Work Relaxant
4801716.description: A prescription containing the recipes for the Strain Reliever and Calming Potion. Used to treat chronic rage from endless revisions.
4801716.story:
Recipe:

Revising our work is inevitable when writing papers, submitting proposals, or drafting reports. In mild cases, it can lead to headaches, but in more extreme situations, it can cause a nervous breakdown.

For patients only experiencing a <style="highlight">headache</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Strain Reliever</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">hexaflowers</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">bitterberries</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">frostcrystals</style>.
This potion helps them calm down while also revitalizing their energy.

For patients already in a state of <style="highlight">agitation</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Calming Potion</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">hexaflowers</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">bitterberries</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">frostcrystals</style>.
This potion clears the mind and brings about a sense of tranquility.

The above herbs must be simmered over <style="highlight">low heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.

Are you a student working on a paper? A designer revising your work? This potion is for you!

4801717.name: Efficiency Extract
4801717.description: A prescription containing the recipes for the Alertness Tonic and Energy Elixir. Used to treat sluggishness and procrastination.
4801717.story:
Recipe:

Do you find yourself getting easily distracted whenever it's time to work? Do you always procrastinate until the deadline is right around the corner? Believe me, even the famous Lord Ravion struggles with this issue!

For patients <style="highlight">struggling to focus</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Alertness Tonic</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">frostcrystals</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">glowfly fruits</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">jumping beans</style>.
This potion keeps creativity flowing, sharpens concentration, and boosts productivity!

For completely <style="highlight">inactive</style> patients,
they need the <style="highlight">Energy Elixir</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">frostcrystals</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">glowfly fruits</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">jumping beans</style>.
This potion helps the patients overcome procrastination and get them into immediate action!

The above herbs must be boiled over <style="highlight">high heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
If you find it hard to focus on the work you love, give the above potion a try!

4801718.name: Humility Tonic
4801718.description: A prescription containing the recipes for the Soul Relaxant and Fervor Potion. Used to treat swollen egos and stiff necks.
4801718.story:
Recipe:

Following the rise of the heroes, many have experienced unprecedented changes in their status and identity, and some get so caught up in their newfound glory that they can't quite snap out of it. At times like these, a little potion is just what they need to bring them back to reality!

For patients suffering from mild shoulder and neck pain from <style="highlight">holding their heads high for extended periods</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Soul Relaxant</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">bitterberries</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">rock mushrooms</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">parasol mushrooms</style>.
This potion encourages self-reflection, rekindles their dreams, and helps improve shoulder and neck mobility.

For overly arrogant patients <style="highlight">stiff from neck to arms and back</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Fervor Potion</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">bitterberries</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">rock mushrooms</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">parasol mushrooms</style>.
This potion helps reignite their motivation and move them forward toward their dreams.

The above herbs must be boiled over <style="highlight">high heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
If you or your friends and family are suffering from these symptoms, it's best to take this potion without delay! Remember—glory fades the moment it is attained, and humility is what carries us forward!

4801719.name: Confidence Tonic
4801719.description: A prescription containing the recipes for the Esteem Elixir and Courage Elixir. Used to treat despair and back/leg pains.
4801719.story:
Recipe:

After the Queen was overthrown, the heroes of Sal'thorin seized control of the city. Many who once held positions of power have faced dramatic shifts in their social standing. For some, the anxiety brought on by these changes has begun to take a toll on both their daily lives and work.

For patients who can't help but <style="highlight">hunch their backs out of self-doubt and fear</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Esteem Elixir</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">jumping beans</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">pride antlers</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">parasol mushrooms</style>.
This potion helps restore confidence!

For patients suffering from <style="highlight">severe lower back and leg pain brought on by prolonged fear</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Courage Elixir</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">jumping beans</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">pride antlers</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> o <style="highlight">parasol mushrooms</style>.
This potion empowers patients to pursue their dreams without pain and fear.

The above herbs must be simmered over <style="highlight">low heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
If you or your loved ones are battling these symptoms, cast aside your fear and take this potion! It's never too late to chase your dreams!

4801720.name: Sincerity Potion
4801720.description: A prescription containing the recipes for the Disillusion Draught and Clarity Tincture. Used to treat those suffering from lovesickness.
4801720.story:
Recipe:

Love has always been complicated. Even now, many still struggle with the challenges of relationships in Sal'thorin.

For patients whose <style="highlight">desperate longing for love leads to delusional thoughts</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Disillusion Draught</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">rock mushrooms</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">phoenix feathers</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">wolf tails</style>.
This potion helps ground patients in reality while reigniting their courage to pursue love.

For patients <style="highlight">consumed by romance</style> to the point that their daily lives are disrupted,
they need the <style="highlight">Clarity Tincture</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">rock mushrooms</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">phoenix feathers</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">wolf tails</style>.
This potion reminds patients to savor the sweetness of love without losing touch with reality.

The above herbs must be boiled over <style="highlight">high heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
While you immerse yourself in the sweetness of love, don't forget to stay grounded in life and remain true to yourself. Only then will love become even more beautiful.

4801721.name: Comfort Potion
4801721.description: A prescription containing the recipes for the Mending Elixir and Heartmend Serum. Used to treat heartbreak after a falling-out.
4801721.story:
Recipe:

As drastic changes reshape the world, social bonds are shifting too. Lately, it is common to see old friends drifting apart, breaking up, or becoming estranged. Some even suffer illness from the emotional pain.

For patients <style="highlight">having trouble communicating after losing touch with friends</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Mending Elixir</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">hexaflowers</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">glowfly fruits</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">wolf tails</style>.
This potion helps patients pull themselves together and open their hearts to friends again.

For <style="highlight">heartbroken</style> patients whose lives are disrupted by the pain of breakups,
they need the <style="highlight">Heartmend Serum</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">hexaflowers</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">glowfly fruits</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">wolf tails</style>.
This potion mends their broken hearts so they can beat strongly again.

The above herbs must be simmered over <style="highlight">low heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
Ending a deeply cherished friendship is undeniably painful. However, if you linger too long in the pain, you are the one who suffers most. Whether you aim to salvage the friendship or move on, the first and most crucial step is to let go of the past and take a step forward.

4801722.name: Adventurer's Potion
4801722.description: A prescription containing the recipes for the Packrat Potion and Glory Brew. Used to treat those obsessed with surface adventures.
4801722.story:
Recipe:

Lately, the call to explore the surface is gaining traction across Sal'thorin. Are you drawn to the sunshine, eager to embark on your own epic adventure? It's a worthy dream—just be careful not to let fantasy overshadow reality.

For patients who simply enjoy collecting a lot of gear and <style="highlight">dressing up like adventurers</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Packrat Potion</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">wolf tails</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">etching irises</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">rot sludge</style>.
This potion helps patients stay level-headed, face reality, and properly prepare for the journey ahead.

For patients <style="highlight">fantasizing about being heroes</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Glory Brew</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">wolf tails</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">etching irises</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">rot sludge</style>.
This potion helps patients retain the courage to forge their own legend, without being trapped in delusions.

The above herbs must be simmered over <style="highlight">low heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
Drink this potion before your adventure begins!

4801723.name: Dream Potion
4801723.description: A prescription containing the recipes for the Wanderlust Elixir and Opendoor Philter. Used to treat those too attached to their underground life.
4801723.story:
Recipe:

Just as some dream of exploring the surface, others long for nothing but a quiet life at home. However, it's important to stay mindful if such desires begin to disrupt daily life.

For patients who simply <style="highlight">dislike going out</style>—so much so that even seeking treatment requires great effort,
they need the <style="highlight">Wanderlust Elixir</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">parasol mushrooms</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">etching irises</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">flamefern</style>.
This potion lifts their spirits and helps them rediscover the joy of going outside.

For patients experiencing <style="highlight">overwhelming panic about the outside world</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Opendoor Philter</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">parasol mushrooms</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">etching irises</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">flamefern</style>.
This potion helps ease their anxiety completely, replacing it with feelings of happiness and curiosity.

The above herbs must be boiled over <style="highlight">high heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
The choice between adventure and a peaceful life at home is yours to make. However, if excessive anxiety or fear starts to interfere with your daily life, a potion might be just the remedy you need!

4801724.name: Use it for everything!
4801724.description: A prescription containing the recipes for the Average Aid and Universal Panacea. Used to treat just about any ailment.
4801724.story:
Recipe:

To prepare an effective potion, one must not only understand the illness itself but also be well-versed in the properties of the herbs. Only by administering the right dosage and precisely controlling the heat can the potion truly cure the disease.

But the process takes time—and as the great Magister, you have far too much on your plate. Sometimes, <style="highlight">randomly</style> tossing in a few herbs and letting the fire <style="highlight">work its magic</style> can lead to something truly special!
Well, if it really exists, might as well call it <style="highlight">Average Aid</style>!

Who knows? A potion like that might just work on all kinds of symptoms! Sure, it may not be perfect every time—but what's so bad about being <style="highlight">average</style>? On the flip side, it might even turn out to be the legendary <style="highlight">Universal Panacea</style> that cures every illness!
If creativity is your thing, just relax and follow your heart!

4801725.name: Hexaflower
4801725.description: A fragrant, sweet herb that brings hope even to the most defeated hearts. Used for brewing potions.

4801726.name: Bitterberry
4801726.description: A bitter herb that snaps the patient awake and reminds them just how harsh reality can be. Used for brewing potions.

4801727.name: Frostcrystal
4801727.description: A mineral ingredient that's hard and cold to the touch, great for clarity and calm. Used for brewing potions.

4801728.name: Glowfly Fruit
4801728.description: A sweet, refreshing, nourishing herb that quickly reawakens brain cells and fuels inspiration. Used for brewing potions.

4801729.name: Jumping Bean
4801729.description: A spicy, stimulating herb that sparks new energy and passion for life. Used for brewing potions.

4801730.name: Pride Antlers
4801730.description: A powdered herb that cheers you up and rebuilds your confidence when you're feeling low. Used for brewing potions.

4801731.name: Rock Mushroom
4801731.description: A mildly bitter, slightly salty herb that reminds the patient to stay humble and reassess their own strength. Used for brewing potions.

4801732.name: Parasol Mushroom
4801732.description: A soft, sweet herb that brings you joy and reminds you of the dreams and hopes that carried you this far. Used for brewing potions.

4801733.name: Phoenix Feather
4801733.description: A rare herb said to enhance charm, favored by nobles who care about class and charisma. Used for brewing potions.

4801734.name: Wolf Tail
4801734.description: A sun-dried herb known to lift spirits and restore both courage and confidence. Used for brewing potions.

4801735.name: Etching Iris
4801735.description: A unique-tasting, exotic herb that stirs curiosity and a longing for freedom. Used for brewing potions.

4801736.name: Flamefern
4801736.description: A spicy herb that drives out the cold—works wonders on anxiety and panic, too. Used for brewing potions.

4801737.name: Rot Sludge
4801737.description: A thick, gooey herb with a bizarre taste, capable of snapping patients out of delusions and back to reality. Used for brewing potions.

4801738.name: Strain Reliever
4801738.description: A potion that calms the patient's nerves and perks them up. Used to treat Splitting Headache.

4801739.name: Calming Potion
4801739.description: A potion that clears the mind and brings peace. Used to treat Unyielding Mania.

4801740.name: Alertness Tonic
4801740.description: A potion that fuels inspiration, sharpens focus, and boosts productivity. Used to treat Mentis Dispersia.

4801741.name: Energy Elixir
4801741.description: A potion that gets the patient up and moving. Used to treat Chronic Lethargy.

4801742.name: Soul Relaxant
4801742.description: A potion that brings clarity and eases neck tension. Used to treat High-Head Syndrome.

4801743.name: Fervor Potion
4801743.description: A potion that reawakens the body and mind through the call of a dream. Helps the patient let go of past burdens and pain. Used to treat Rigor Arrogantis.

4801744.name: Esteem Elixir
4801744.description: A potion that helps the patient regain their confidence. Used to treat Gutless Hunch.

4801745.name: Courage Elixir
4801745.description: A potion that rekindles the patient's dreams and wipes away their fear and pain. Used to treat Cowering Pain.

4801746.name: Disillusion Draught
4801746.description: A potion that helps the patient see the truth without losing the courage to chase love. Used to treat Cupid's Delirium.

4801747.name: Clarity Tincture
4801747.description: A potion that helps the patient remember the sweetness of love while staying grounded in reality. Used to treat Lover's Haze.

4801748.name: Mending Elixir
4801748.description: A potion that helps the patient open their heart and rediscover the joy of conversation. Used to treat Unfriending Pox.

4801749.name: Heartmend Serum
4801749.description: A potion that gets even the most broken heart beating again. Used to treat Lovelorn Lurgy.

4801750.name: Packrat Potion
4801750.description: A potion that helps the patient see reality and get ready for real adventures. Used to treat Adventurer's Itch.

4801751.name: Glory Brew
4801751.description: A potion that snaps the patient out of world-saving fantasies without losing the courage to pursue greatness. Used to treat Heroic Delirium.

4801752.name: Wanderlust Elixir
4801752.description: A potion that lifts the patient's mood, opens them up, and helps them enjoy going out again. Used to treat Homebody Blues.

4801753.name: Opendoor Philter
4801753.description: A potion that calms the mind with joy and curiosity, easing the fear of the outside world. Used to treat Hermit Hiccups.

4801754.name: Average Aid
4801754.description: A potion born from magic and insight, a physical embodiment of the great magister's free will. Slightly effective against all ailments.

4801755.name: Universal Panacea
4801755.description: A perfect potion refined through wisdom and skill, the crowning achievement of Sal'thorin's master healer. Highly effective against all ailments.

4801756.name: Fleshy Prism Trout
4801756.description: A rare delicacy in the commoners' district, cherished for its vivid hues and succulent meat.

4801757.name: Fungus Trout Soup
4801757.description: A clear, savory broth where the delicate sweetness of trout pairs perfectly with earthy wild mushrooms.

4801758.name: Grimberry
4801758.description: Though its leaves carry a bitter scent, its fruit is exceptionally sweet and has pain-relieving properties.

4801759.name: Rock Moss
4801759.description: This hardy moss clings to rocks and contains minerals that help preserve medicinal potions.

4801760.name: Fuzzy Mushroom
4801760.description: This common mushroom species has a soft texture and tastes even better when dried. The thick-grilled variant is known for its pain-relieving properties.

4801761.name: Healing Ointment
4801761.description: Cool and herb-scented, this ointment dulls pain and helps wounds close faster.

4801766.name: Brimstone Loaf
4801766.description: Dwarven-made and irresistibly soft, this sweet bread is a humble luxury.

4801767.name: Clinic Open
4801767.story:
With strange illnesses on the rise in Sal'thorin, and with Lord Ravion's personal approval, the clinic is now officially open for business.

Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> will be handling consultations and treatments personally.

If you feel unwell, don't wait. Come get checked!


<align="right">Sal'thorin Guards

4801768.name: Case Report
4801768.story:
To all citizens of Sal'thorin:

Following an investigation by Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, recent public health issues have been linked to elevated spore levels. Heightened anxiety and stress may also cause unusual symptoms.

Here's what you can do:

Keep rooms well ventilated. Spend more time in open areas. Avoid areas with high spore levels.

The guards will soon begin cleanup operations in the Green Cap Valley and Sporeveil Grove to improve air quality.

No need to panic. Stay calm. If you're feeling unwell, visit the clinic anytime.


<align="right">Sal'thorin Guards

4801769.name: Sketchy Bottle
4801769.description: A vial, carelessly discarded, holds the dregs of a sinister mind-altering substance.

4801770.name: Wood
4801770.description: A natural hardwood with tight grain and an extremely dense texture.

4801771.name: Stone
4801771.description: The premium building stone of the Essail's royal city, cut with perfect precision and built to last ages.

4801772.name: Common Dew Cichlid
4801772.description: Beautiful to look at with its shimmering scales, but otherwise just an ordinary fish.

4801773.name: Fleshy Rainwraith
4801773.description: This plump fish can rocket out of the water with surprising force.

4801774.name: Mirage Bloom
4801774.description: A rare bloom that grew only in the Dark Forest and the Vaduso Mountains until Feli rediscovered how to cultivate it in Sal'thorin.

4801778.name: Work Relaxant (I)
4801778.description: A case note containing the recipe for Strain Reliever, used to treat Splitting Headaches.

4801779.name: Work Relaxant (II)
4801779.description: A case note containing the recipe for Calming Potion, used to treat Unyielding Mania.

4801780.name: Efficiency Extract (I)
4801780.description: A case note containing the recipe for Alertness Tonic, used to treat Mentis Dispersia.

4801781.name: Efficiency Extract (II)
4801781.description: A case note containing the recipe for Energy Elixir, used to treat Chronic Lethargy.

4801782.name: Humility Tonic (I)
4801782.description: A case note containing the recipe for Soul Relaxant, used to treat High-Head Syndrome.

4801783.name: Humility Tonic (II)
4801783.description: A case note containing the recipe for Fervor Potion, used to treat Rigor Arrogantis.

4801784.name: Confidence Tonic (I)
4801784.description: A case note containing the recipe for Esteem Elixir, used to treat Gutless Hunch.

4801785.name: Confidence Tonic (II)
4801785.description: A case note containing the recipe for Courage Elixir, used to treat Cowering Pain.

4801786.name: Sincerity Potion (I)
4801786.description: A case note containing the recipe for Disillusion Draught, used to treat Cupid's Delirium.

4801787.name: Sincerity Potion (II)
4801787.description: A case note containing the recipe for Clarity Tincture, used to treat Lover's Haze.

4801788.name: Comfort Potion (I)
4801788.description: A case note containing the recipe for Mending Elixir, used to treat Unfriending Pox.

4801789.name: Comfort Potion (II)
4801789.description: A case note containing the recipe for Heartmend Serum, used to treat Lovelorn Lurgy.

4801790.name: Adventurer's Potion (I)
4801790.description: A case note containing the recipe for Packrat Potion, used to treat Adventurer's Itch.

4801791.name: Adventurer's Potion (II)
4801791.description: A case note containing the recipe for Glory Brew, used to treat Heroic Delirium.

4801792.name: Dream Potion (I)
4801792.description: A case note containing the recipe for Wanderlust Elixir, used to treat Homebody Blues.

4801793.name: Dream Potion (II)
4801793.description: A case note containing the recipe for Opendoor Philter, used to treat Hermit Hiccups.

4801800.name: Use it for everything!
4801800.description: A prescription containing the recipes for the Average Aid and Universal Panacea. Used to treat just about any ailment.

4801801.name: Sinned Scale
4801801.description: A uniquely shaped scale dropped by the corrupted Essail, called the Sinned One.

4801802.name: Earth Essence
4801802.description: Elemental essence drawn from the Stone Warden, brimming with the raw power of the earth.

5801666.name: Letter to Warner
5801666.description: A father who missed his son wrote this letter. It is found in the ruins of Tuttleton.

5801667.name: Diary Fragment 1
5801667.description: This tattered piece of paper appears to be part of Old Mason's journal.

5801668.name: Diary Fragment 2
5801668.description: This tattered piece of paper appears to be part of Old Mason's journal.

5801669.name: Diary Fragment 3
5801669.description: This tattered piece of paper appears to be part of Old Mason's journal.

5801670.name: Eroded Knife
5801670.description: This severely eroded bevel knife is etched with the scars of time.
5801670.comment: As long as the knife exists, the legacy remains.

5801671.name: Carvable Stone
5801671.description: Old Mason's tomb is made from this stone. In the ruins of Tuttleton, even a large stone is a rare find.

5801688.name: Necklace Beads
5801688.description: These beads seem to have been torn from Gala's necklace.
5801688.comment: Only vibrant colors are truly pure.

5801689.name: Spiky Coconut
5801689.description: Inside the fruit's spiky shell are its sweet juice and delicious flesh. It is one of the ingredients for the divine elixir.

5801690.name: Spiralfern
5801690.description: This plant, with curled leaves and a faint scent, is common in swamps. It is one of the ingredients for the divine elixir.

5801691.name: Honey
5801691.description: Anyone with a sweet tooth would love honey for its rich texture and sweet flavor. It is one of the ingredients for the divine elixir.

5801692.name: Revival Tonic
5801692.description: This potion can revive the dead and emits a faint glow in complete darkness.
5801692.comment: Nothing works as well as this panacea.

5801695.name: Letter to Lygos
5801695.description: Zel, the outpost soldier captain, wrote this letter to Lieutenant Lygos, detailing how Matthew made candy from a petal umbrella for the children.

5801699.name: Divine Elixir
5801699.description: This elixir is originally an offering for the Hunting Goddess, said to be consumed by her before every battle.
5801699.comment: Even the gods couldn't resist this.

5801711.name: Anton's Medal
5801711.description: This badge is worn by every Halian soldier. It belonged to Anton and symbolizes his glory. Take it to his mother, Nelia, in Halia.
5801711.comment: A testament to one's unwavering resolve in safeguarding Halia.

5801712.name: Dragonblood Leaf
5801712.description: This plant thrives in highlands where fierce winds blow, its leaves the color of congealed blood. It is one of the ingredients for the antiemetic potion.

5801713.name: Zen Orchid
5801713.description: This inconspicuous plant has tiny leaves and roots that grow deep underground. It is one of the ingredients for the antiemetic potion.

5801714.name: Stargrass
5801714.description: Its fruits adorn the branches like stars in the sky. It is one of the ingredients for the antiemetic potion.

5801715.name: Antiemetic Potion
5801715.description: An antidote brewed from a variety of herbs, releasing a subtle, earthy aroma. Highly effective against food poisoning, nausea, and stomach discomfort.

5801762.name: Mana-Focusing Potion
5801762.description: Morgan's mana-focusing potion. It can temporarily enhance the control and focus of magic users.

5801763.name: Fresh Specterfin
5801763.description: While one is alive and the other a mere soul, their unbreakable bond keeps them inseparable. It is one of the ingredients for the mana-focusing potion.

5801764.name: Petal Umbrella
5801764.description: The patterns on this mushroom have a hypnotic effect. It is one of the ingredients for the mana-focusing potion.

5801765.name: Ghostwood Powder
5801765.description: This powder, ground from ghostwood, gleams beautifully like a cluster of tiny crystals. It is one of the ingredients for the mana-focusing potion.

5801776.name: Spiky Coconut
5801776.description: This fruit has abundant juice inside its hard, spiky shell. It is one of the hawk moth's favorite foods.

5801777.name: Petal Umbrella
5801777.description: The hypnotic patterns on this mushroom's cap can induce severe hallucinations if it is not properly prepared.

5801803.name: Tablet - Disk
5801803.description: A glowing golden disk is drawn on this stone tablet. It seems to be part of a mural.
5801803.comment: It attracts both humans and monsters alike.

5801804.name: Tablet - Town
5801804.description: A depiction of a town is drawn on this stone tablet, expelled by the Wailing Oak. It seems to be part of the Harvest Altar's mural.

5801805.name: Tablet - Mist
5801805.description: Mist-like colors are painted on this stone tablet, found by Gala. It seems to be part of the Harvest Altar's mural.

5801806.name: Tully's Key
5801806.description: This uniquely designed wooden key is the only key capable of unlocking the door to the light source.
5801806.comment: It can still be used despite its worn-out condition.

5801807.name: Sedecim's Heart
5801807.description: The glowing light source in Sedecim's chest holds the residual magic from past generations of priests. It grants Sedecim consciousness and the ability to move.

5801808.name: Holyberry
5801808.description: Despite its unassuming appearance, it contains vast divine energy. It is one of the ingredients for the revival tonic.
5801808.comment: Priced highly due to its scarcity.

5801809.name: Grimwell Tears
5801809.description: According to legend, this translucent teardrop forms only once every century at the bottom of the Grim River. It is one of the ingredients for the revival tonic.
5801809.comment: A mix of liquid and solid.

5801810.name: Dreadvine Leaves
5801810.description: It flourishes in mana-rich areas, its delicate leaves brimming with magic. It is one of the ingredients for the revival tonic.

5801811.name: Memory - Spear
5801811.description: This magic-crafted memory sphere stores the moment when Perseus and Gorgonna first met each other.

5801812.name: Memory - Charm
5801812.description: This magic-crafted memory sphere stores the moment when Gorgonna gave Perseus a charm.
5801812.comment: "It'll keep you safe. From now on, you won't be anyone's prey."

5801813.name: Memory - Statue
5801813.description: This magic-crafted memory sphere stores the moment when Perseus and Gorgonna parted ways.
5801813.comment: "In the next life, wait for me."

5801814.name: Tiny Flower
5801814.description: Nanri intends to bring back these Tuttleton flowers to commemorate her destroyed homeland and the loved ones she has lost.

5801815.name: Dull Wheat Seeds
5801815.description: Merlin the First once attempted planting Halian wheat elsewhere, but the results were not promising.

5801816.name: Anesthetics
5801816.description: This potion can temporarily numb the nerves. It is the most sought-after item after a war.

5801817.name: Phantoleaf
5801817.description: This handful of tender, delicate plants possesses excellent healing properties. It is one of the ingredients for anesthetics.

5801818.name: Fresh Swamp Frog
5801818.description: Its skin bears ever-shifting patterns, and direct contact causes numbness from the hidden toxins. It is one of the ingredients for anesthetics.
5801818.comment: Avoid touching it with your bare hands!

5801819.name: Endurabud
5801819.description: Abundius picked these common Halian flowers to decorate Perseus' tomb. They can survive harsh conditions.
5801819.comment: May there be no more separations.

5801820.name: Halia Rocks
5801820.description: Abundius collected these rocks from the outskirts of Halia to decorate Perseus' tomb. They are as tough as the Halians themselves.

5801821.name: Hemp Fiber
5801821.description: This common highland plant becomes incredibly resilient once dried. It is one of the materials used to lengthen ropes.

5801822.name: Tree Bark
5801822.description: This common bark is extremely difficult to break. It is one of the materials used to lengthen ropes.

5801823.name: Morgan's Notebook
5801823.description: The handwriting in this journal is almost illegible. Clearly, it belongs to Morgan.

5801824.name: Crimson Pearl
5801824.description: Hawk moths have eyespots on their wings imbued with magic. Though the eyespots may seem to move, it is merely an illusion.

5801830.name: Berries
5801830.description: The berries are scattered all around the fruit plate. Something unexpected might happen once you place them back...

5801837.name: Prismatic Cacao
5801837.description: When fully ripe, its shell turns vibrant, and the cocoa beans inside are ideal for making desserts.
5801837.comment: Is it just me, or does this thing look like a mouth with teeth?

5801838.name: Wild Bitter Corn
5801838.description: This wild grain is commonly found in arid regions. With its rough texture and bitter taste, it makes perfect livestock feed.
5801838.comment: Not recommended for human consumption, unless there is no other choice.

5801839.name: Spiky Coconut
5801839.description: Its tough and spiky shell can be forged into a weapon or shield.
5801839.comment: Good thing they don't grow on treetops.

5801840.name: Petal Umbrella
5801840.description: The concentric patterns on its cap might appear to spin if stared at for too long. Careful preparation is required when cooking it to avoid its potent hallucinogenic effects.

5801841.name: Wild Tune Sprout
5801841.description: The question mark on a tune sprout can be used to predict the weather. If the question mark is droopy, it signals an impending rain.
5801841.comment: Not an accurate weather forecaster, except when it comes to rainy days.

5801843.name: Traditional Stew
5801843.description: All the ingredients have fused into a symphony of flavors... behold the legendary Wildborn taste!

5801844.name: Exotic Stew
5801844.description: I've eaten my way across Wildborn lands, I've even been to Halia, and nothing compares to this!

5801845.name: Memorable Stew
5801845.description: An audacious medley of spices, leaving an imprint on your very soul.

5801846.name: Strange Trinket
5801846.description: Someone slipped this into your bag without you noticing. It is an exquisite trinket: a dark figure with bandages haphazardly wrapped around its head, glaring at you fiercely with its beady eyes.

5801848.name: Rattan Bracelet
5801848.description: This rattan bracelet is said to be a token of the Midnight Fright Club.

5801850.name: Tools
5801850.description: These tools can be used to assemble the puppet.

5801851.name: Energy Core
5801851.description: Drawn from the light of the Harvest Altar, this strand of energy can power the puppet.

5801852.name: Round Stone
5801852.description: This perfectly round stone could serve as a replacement for one of Oman's eyes.

5801854.name: Fang Necklace
5801854.description: Each beast fang on this necklace is smooth and gleaming, the result of its owner's constant, affectionate handling.

5801855.name: Pendant
5801855.description: This modest pendant is made extraordinary by the love it embodies.

5801856.name: Lobeleaf
5801856.description: This herb grows only on cliffs and is an effective antidote for snake venom.

5801877.name: Wooden Sword
5801877.description: The blade of this hand-crafted short sword is blunt. It feels more like a reward for a child who has completed an adventure.

5801878.name: Worn Badge
5801878.description: This badge bears an evergreen emblem, symbolizing the Paeon school.
5801878.comment: It is a glimmer of hope within darkness and drought.

5801879.name: Ripe Bitter Corn
5801879.description: These wild crops manage to produce a few ears of grain despite the God of Harvest's curse. They can be used as livestock feed.

5801880.name: Sandstone Nuts
5801880.description: You are lucky to even find fruits on this slightly withered shrub.
5801880.comment: Even some the most resilient crops cannot withstand the fallen god's curse.

5801881.name: Violet Veilleaf
5801881.description: These purple-tinged leaves can stabilize wounds and calm the mind.

5801882.name: Velorind Plant
5801882.description: This pale white plant is known to cleanse both body and mind.

5801883.name: Healing Potion
5801883.description: This clear, pale green elixir serves as an effective cure for common ailments.

5801884.name: Scattered Bread
5801884.description: This burned bread was dropped from Niya's stall.
5801884.comment: It is a delicacy in times of famine.

5801885.name: Scattered Nuts
5801885.description: These sandstone nuts were dropped from Niya's stall. They are of higher quality than those found in Halia.

5801886.name: Key
5801886.description: This key, hidden inside a crate in the guards' break room, can set Anton free.

5801893.name: Gala's Leaf
5801893.description: Chosen by Gala, the leaf grows alone on a bare branch.

5801894.name: Guardian Leaf
5801894.description: This accessory is made from a leaf handpicked by Gala; it carries all her best wishes.
5801894.comment: If I had a daughter, I would wish for her to be like this pure, innocent girl.

5801903.name: Important Statement
5801903.story:
Rumors of a so-called "kin of the fallen goddess" lurking in our lands are entirely unfounded. As the foremost authority on this matter, I issue this statement to set the record straight.

The <style="highlight">Gilded Serpent</style> was a humble offering I once presented at a living sacrifice to the Herdmaster. Displeased by its plain form, the deity bestowed upon it golden scales and three heads.

Despite its fearsome appearance, the Gilded Serpent is harmless. Should you encounter one of these rare creatures in the <style="highlight">swamps</style> at <style="highlight">midnight</style>, DO NOT harm it! The Herdmaster has fallen. Turning your anger upon innocent creatures serves neither justice nor reason.

<align="right">Modra

5801904.name: Calming Yarrow
5801904.description: A calming herb said to ease the body and clear the mind.

5801905.name: Lunar Orchid
5801905.description: Nurtured under moonlight, its very presence relaxes the spirit.
5801905.comment: Gentle as moonlight, soothing to behold.

5801906.name: Quickheal Salve
5801906.description: Thick, red ointment that speeds up wound recovery.

5801907.name: Rare Herb
5801907.description: A rare herb hidden in the soil, Gala even sent the hunting team to find it.

5801908.name: Ripe Spiky Coconut
5801908.description: Grows near water, with a tough shell.

5801909.name: Plump Sawfish
5801909.description: Fanged and ferocious, it's rumored to have bitten more than a few fishermen.
5801909.comment: Snackable, if you have the patience.

5801910.name: Coconut Fish Stew
5801910.description: Cooked with brown coconut and tender sawfish, it's fragrant and deeply flavorful.

5801911.name: Dragonblood Leaf
5801911.description: A common shrub, legend says it was once nourished with dragon's blood.

5801912.name: Waxweed
5801912.description: Rich in oil, often used as a fire-starting aid.

5801913.name: Zen Orchid
5801913.description: Clears the mind. Its fragrance is subtle but unforgettable.

5801914.name: Antidote
5801914.description: Neutralizes common toxins, making it highly effective against food poisoning.

5801915.name: Bitter Corn Feed
5801915.description: Not tasty, but hungry animals won't mind.

5801916.name: Plump Scalewraith
5801916.description: Large, meaty fish; a favorite among aquatic hunters.

5801930.name: Celestine Suspension
5801930.description: Extremely unstable; must be stored in a sealed magic jar. Used as an intermediate for acid solutions.

5801931.name: Plant Purifier
5801931.description: A plant-purifying potion that maintains plant health, removes negative effects, and promotes growth.
5801931.comment: Packed with the perseverance and passion of learned minds.

5801932.name: Magic Amulet
5801932.description: Infused with potent magic, shaped like a scythe; unmistakably Morgan's style.

5801947.name: Divine Gift
5801947.description: Modra's first god-granted item. Well-preserved and still holds traces of divine power after years.
5801947.comment: Witnessed the rise and fall of gods.

5801971.name: Halia Token 1
5801971.description: This token, bearing Halia's emblem, symbolizes friendship with the city. It unlocks Side Story - Rays of Trust.

5801972.name: Halia Token 2
5801972.description: This token, bearing Halia's emblem, symbolizes friendship with the city. It unlocks Side Story - Intensifying Curse.

5801973.name: Halia Token 3
5801973.description: This token, bearing Halia's emblem, symbolizes friendship with the city. It unlocks Side Story - Remnants of a Hero.

5801974.name: Council Token 1
5801974.description: This token, bearing the symbol of magic, comes from the Arcane Council. It unlocks Side Story - Work Preparation.

5801975.name: Council Token 2
5801975.description: This token, bearing the symbol of magic, comes from the Arcane Council. It unlocks Side Story - Secret of Corruption.

5801976.name: Council Token 3
