5801977.name: Wildborn Token 1
5801977.description: This token, bearing a tribal totem, symbolizes friendship with the Wildborn. It unlocks Side Story - Residual Power.

5801978.name: Wildborn Token 2
5801978.description: This token, bearing a tribal totem, symbolizes friendship with the Wildborn. It unlocks Side Story - Hearts Amid Hardship.

5801979.name: Wildborn Token 3
5801979.description: This token, bearing a tribal totem, symbolizes friendship with the Wildborn. It unlocks Side Story - Beyond Hatred.

6801794.name: Suspicious Letter
6801794.description: A mysterious letter that somehow appeared in the homestead.

6801795.name: Lyceum Map
6801795.description: A map of the Serene Lyceum from Zorya.

6801796.name: Missing Page
6801796.description: The lost transfiguration rulebook page Contess has been searching for. Don't keep her waiting.

6801797.name: Transfiguration for Dummies
6801797.description: A beginner's book for transfiguration from Contess. Hamster? Wolf? Which one to start with?
6801797.story:
Through transfiguration, you can roam the world as a quadruped or perceive tiny details as a rodent.
Silently recite the incantation and picture your chosen form in your mind. Open your pores and your heart. Let your skin sense the pulse of nature and allow your soul to resonate with the animal's spirit.
Rule 1: Transfiguration alters your physical form, but your mind remains unaffected.
Rule 2: Every creature has its own language. To understand what is indecipherable to humans, you must assume the appropriate form.
Rule 3: Transfiguration won't deprive you of reason or soul. For instance, those who transform into dolphins won't remain in the ocean forever, unless they do so and use transfiguration as an excuse.
Rule 4: There are more than four rules.
(The handbook is packed with dozens of rules and prohibitions, followed by an appendix titled "108 Emergency Measures for Common Transfiguration Mistakes", and an appendix to the appendix titled "What to Do When You Cannot Access the Handbook". There are over a hundred pages beyond that, but you decide to stop reading here.)

6801798.name: Lyceum's Badge
6801798.description: A student badge crafted by Contess using rule-weaving. Flawless in every practical way.
6801798.comment: A lie so perfect is the truth itself.

6801799.name: Registered Badge
6801799.description: A student badge certified by the Mouth of Truth, confirming successful entry into the Court Mage Selection Exam.

6801825.name: Cassadee's Notebook
6801825.description: Cassadee carries it wherever she goes. Packed with reading notes, experiment drafts, and spell improvements.
6801825.comment: 40, 41, 42... and there it is. Notebook No. 43!
6801825.story:
Forge the body of the key with <style="highlight">bluefire steel</style>.

The key must be embedded with a highly pure magic crystal. For me, the <style="highlight">goldprism crystal</style> is the best choice. It's the purest crystal available to students, though it comes at a steep price.

When making multiple, double the materials and repeat the steps in the same order.

As for the small reactive force field, I've already detailed the spell formula in one of my papers. It shouldn't be a problem!
The crystals can be purchased from the campus store, but bluefire steel... Hmm, if I'm not mistaken, the campus guards are made from this metal...

6801826.name: Bluefire Steel
6801826.description: A material used to forge the sundial keys. Lightweight and very responsive to magic.
6801826.comment: They say this is the same steel used to forge Lyceum guards.

6801827.name: Goldprism Crystal
6801827.description: A material used to forge the sundial keys. A crystal extracted from high-purity magic ore.
6801827.comment: Almost too lavish for a student's lab supply.

6801828.name: Sundial Key
6801828.description: A magical key that activates the sundial.
6801828.comment: Insert it, channel mana, and activate.

6801832.name: Vitality Essence
6801832.description: A liquid with medicinal properties refined from a magical insect. One of the ingredients for the Crescent Elixir.

6801833.name: Moonleaves
6801833.description: A strange magical plant that boosts mana recovery. The main ingredient for the Crescent Elixir.

6801834.name: Fiery Plasma
6801834.description: Boiling monster plasma. Looks unsettling, but it makes everything else mix perfectly. One of the ingredients for the Crescent Elixir.

6801835.name: Crescent Elixir
6801835.description: A special potion that dramatically accelerates healing and restores stamina and focus. Usable only by mages.

6801836.name: Wooden Box
6801836.description: An exquisitely crafted wooden box, holding a secret item custom-made by Cranky at Merlin's request.
6801836.comment: The box's decoration and the weight makes you wonder what's inside.

6801842.name: Merlin Portrait
6801842.description: The Magister Merlin's portrait. The most popular edition you'll find in shops.

6801853.name: Crumpled Sheet
6801853.description: A cheat sheet dug out of a stump in the Whisperwood, packed with Magic History notes... clearly made by a student who chose making cheats over actually revising.
6801853.comment: Text is nearly microscopic. Could've used an extension spell.

6801860.name: Note on Class
6801860.description: The slip is a relic from that unruly school era, "smuggled" hand-to-hand in class.
6801860.comment: Two students got caught passing notes in class and were asked to do after-school cleaning.
6801860.story:
What's wrong with the seat next to me? Why did you suddenly move away after the results came out?
...
Why won't you talk to me? Is it because of the results?
...
Come on, don't be so grumpy! The professor almost thought you were glaring at him just now.
<style="highlight">It's not what it looks like.</style>
Second place is still pretty good, right? You only missed the bonus question.
<style="highlight">Seriously, drop it.</style>
...
<style="highlight">That bonus question was about Starshower, and the professor never even mentioned it in class! How did you manage to pull it off and score full marks?</style>
Finally, you're talking. I picked that up myself after class. If you're interested, I can show you how to do it at the observatory. What do you say?

6801861.name: Stargazing Journal
6801861.description: Records a story that once happened at the observatory back in the school days.
6801861.story:
I worked with Cyran to break down the Starshower spell, just like we planned. Honestly, I love talking about magic with him, even if he drives me crazy sometimes. It always sparks all these interesting ideas in my head.

That conversation got me thinking. Maybe I should start my observations with that constellation today. I really hope I catch something ancient again...

(Illegible observation log)

Cyran came along to stargaze with me, but... well, he's not exactly great at it. He didn't see anything.

He seemed kind of upset about it. Maybe I should plan a surprise to cheer him up next time?

Starshower made the night sky light up with a gorgeous meteor shower! That's honestly one of the reasons I love it so much!

Too bad my plan wasn't perfect. Cyran was excited at first, but when he figured out it was from Starshower, his mood changed. He said I shouldn't have wasted his time with such a "useless" spell.

It stung when he said that about my favorite spell. How could it be useless when it brings luck and joy to anyone who sees it?

Magic is supposed to make people happy, right? From that angle, Starshower might just be the most powerful spell in Esperia!

He just sneered when I said that. To him, magic's all about power, and anything like Starshower is just a fun trick with no real use.

Oh well, I guess we'll just have to agree to disagree.

6801862.name: Sundial Mechanics
6801862.description: The design principles of the sundial's magical mechanics, explained firsthand by its creator, Professor Winston.
6801862.comment: Don't forget to write a thesis afterward.

6801863.name: Intel Piece - Meteor Shower
6801863.description: A piece of intel, detailing the Astra Throne and Starshower.

6801864.name: Intel Piece - Merlin's Tower
6801864.description: A piece of intel, detailing Merlin's secret magic tower.

6801865.name: Classified Memory Star
6801865.description: A Memory Star containing something highly confidential about the Arcane Council.
6801865.comment: Ultra-classified intel for Merlin's eyes only.

6801866.name: Custom Memory Star
6801866.description: A Memory Star Merlin made on purpose, stuffed with absolutely unimportant trivia. Hand it to Cyran and you won't have to worry about any secrets leaking.
6801866.comment:
How to make Cyran lose his temper?
That's right up Merlin's alley.

6801867.name: Evie's Letter
6801867.description: A letter Evie sent to Merlin, containing her preliminary results from Gervan's interrogation.

6801868.description: A box found in an empty coffin, with a magic seal on it.

6801869.name: Herbal Tea Recipe
6801869.description: A recipe for an extraordinary herbal tea!
6801869.comment: Just in case, has anyone tested it before?
6801869.story:
Forget about good grades or a prestigious background! All you need is courage and curiosity to gather the ingredients for this <style="highlight">extraordinary herbal tea</style>!
Ingredients: <style="highlight">black tea</style>, <style="highlight">singing leaves</style>, <style="highlight">moon flowers</style>, and <style="highlight">sweet liquid gold</style>.
Instructions: Pour water into a pot and add the moon flowers. Bring to a boil, then add black tea and singing leaves. Once the mixture has cooled slightly, stir in <style="highlight">a generous amount of sweet liquid gold</style>.
That's it! Give it a try!

6801870.name: Zorya's Riddle 1
6801870.comment: The answer is hidden in the past, buried in conflicts, and whispered in cheerful chatters.
6801870.story:
<style="highlight">Once bustling and crowded, this place now stands deserted, its gates firmly closed. Make a guess.</style>
The answer is hidden in the <style="highlight">past</style>, <style="highlight">buried in conflicts, and whispered in cheerful chatters</style>.

6801871.name: Zorya's Riddle 2
6801871.comment: The answer is hidden in the contraband, buried in secrets, and embedded in knowledge.
6801871.story:
<style="highlight">Who passes judgment on every wrong?</style> <style="highlight">What is unseen and formless, yet can calm all chaos?</style>
<style="highlight">The answer is hidden in the contraband,</style> <style="highlight">buried in secrets, and embedded in knowledge.</style>

6801872.name: Zorya's Riddle 3
6801872.comment: The answer lies in somewhere warm, tucked among the flowers, and resting at the bottom of the teacup.
6801872.story:
<style="highlight">This place is bathed in sunshine and filled with blooming flowers. This person can ease pain and offer comfort. Make a guess.</style>
The answer lies in <style="highlight">somewhere warm</style>, <style="highlight">tucked among the flowers, and resting at the bottom of the teacup</style>.

6801873.name: Honey
6801873.description: A jar of fresh, sweet honey.

6801874.name: Glimmerbloom Leaf
6801874.description: Leaves plucked from the top of a glimmerbloom.

6801876.name: Herbal Tea
6801876.description: An herbal tea brewed from the ingredients you deduced.
6801876.comment: That's all? The extraordinary herbal tea?

6801887.name: Eyes on You
6801887.description: First-person horror. The protagonist is around 30, desperate enough to pray to a magic mirror... and doomed enough to be swallowed by what answered.
6801887.story:
I stumbled on that special mirror on a typical afternoon. It looked plain and worn, yet I felt an inexplicable pull toward it...
It was as if an enormous space lay beyond the surface, ready to swallow me if I looked too long...
It has to be a magic mirror.
...
Legend says that anyone who prays to the mirror will receive enlightenment.
Countless mages spend their entire lives searching for a magic mirror, and now one stands right before me. Yet I can't bring myself to decide… A voice in my head tells me that once I pray to it, something will change—irreversibly.
...
I prayed to the mirror.
...
I can feel my magic growing stronger... I've been enlightened! I'm about to go beyond my limits and reach a level I could never attain before!
...
<style="highlight">Someone's watching me.</style>

6801888.name: Curse-Lifting Potion
6801888.description: A potion recorded in an ancient tome, used to undo the mirror's clone-conjuring magic.

6801889.name: Oath of Glory
6801889.description: The heirloom of House Grenvalden, a glint of their former glory.
6801889.comment: Where the oath points, there glory returns.

6801890.name: Corrosive Solution
6801890.description: A dangerously corrosive liquid, but perfect for restoring Silven's heirloom.

6801891.name: Phoenix Star
6801891.description: A magic ruby Gervan gave Silven that shimmers like a living fire.

6801892.name: Sundial Hole
6801892.description: A small hole at the sundial's center, ringed with an old quote: Time reveals all things. The size and shape suggest it was made for a key.
6801892.story:
An ancient saying is engraved around the small hole at the center of the sundial.
"Time reveals all things."

6801895.name: Sundial Keys
6801895.description: An alchemically forged key that activates the sundial.
6801895.comment: Insert it, channel mana, and activate.

6801896.name: Lumengrass Concentrate
6801896.description: A refined cleansing concentrate distilled from large amounts of lumengrass. One of the ingredients for the reagent.

6801897.name: Mutated Venom Gland
6801897.description: A gland harvested from a special magical creature. One of the ingredients for the reagent.

6801898.name: Red Chestnut Pollen
6801898.description: Pollen collected from red chestnut trees. One of the ingredients for the reagent.

6801899.name: Spell Reagent
6801899.description: A solution brewed from lumengrass concentrate, mutated venom glands, and red chestnut pollen. Used to reveal a spell formula in the form of a magic circle.

6801900.name: Cemetery Inscription
6801900.story:
This place is both your creation and your resting place.
Here, the cornerstones of magic are laid, and divine knowledge is passed down.
In the name of magic,
We shall remember you, Lyceum.

6801901.name: Intel Piece - Memory Star
6801901.description: A piece of intel, detailing the Memory Star.

6801902.name: Intel Piece - Magic Door
6801902.description: A piece of intel, detailing the portal to the secret place.

6801917.name: Calming Tonic
6801917.description: A potion Anathyme developed to soothe Rocky.

6801918.name: Honeyfruit
6801918.description: Rocky's favorite honeyfruit. Fresh, juicy, and sweet.

6801919.name: Coldfire Oil
6801919.description: The go-to fusion reagent for enchanted weapon forging. The only reliable way to merge materials into a single whole.

6801920.name: Firevein Ore
6801920.description: An extremely rare ore prized for weapons and armor, so valuable the Lightbearer keeps it under strict control.

6801921.name: Lovesbane Potion
6801921.description: A potion usually used to neutralize love potions. Handle with care.

6801922.name: Crumpled Sheet
6801922.description: A cheat sheet dug out of a stump in the Whisperwood, packed with Magic History notes... clearly made by a student who chose making cheats over actually revising.
6801922.comment: Text is nearly microscopic. Could've used an extension spell.

6801923.name: Transfiguration for Dummies
6801923.description: A beginner's book for transfiguration from Contess. Hamster? Wolf? Which one to start with?

6801924.name: Soothing Remedy
6801924.description: Blended from gentle herbs to boost detox and settle the nerves.

6801925.name: Startear Essence
6801925.description: A single drop of the mysterious potion is said to make any fish soak up nearby light and glow like starlight.

6801926.name: Fisher's Note
6801926.description: A checklist of sightings—where and when the Starglider appeared. Read before you set off, unless you enjoy getting lost.
6801926.story:
According to Hootie, arcane stargliders are in the <style="highlight">rivers and lakes around campus</style> and only come out at <style="highlight">night</style>.
Hootie's usually unreliable, but I'm offering him days off for this information. I bet he won't bluff me this time.
Oh, my beloved starglider! Please do me a favor.
Without you, I might lose my presidency or even get kicked out of school!
If that happens, my father would surely break my fishing rod!

6801927.name: Silverleaf
6801927.description: Leaves with fine silver fuzz, reflecting moonlight in a soft glimmer. They say a single breath of its scent drives impurities away.

6801928.name: Serenboom
6801928.description: Features translucent petals that can be made into a calming brew to ease mana turbulence.

6801929.name: Somnivine
6801929.description: Soft, sweet-scented vines that release a sleep-inducing mist at night, perfect for soothing the spirit.

6801934.name: Strange Piece
6801934.description: A book found by following clues in a mysterious job posting. Title: The Lyceum Library at Three A.M..

6801935.name: Strange Piece
6801935.description: A book found by following clues in a mysterious job posting. Title: The 8 Habits of Highly Effective Mages.

6801936.name: Strange Piece
6801936.description: A book found by following clues in a mysterious job posting. Title: Courage to Overwork.

6801937.name: Intel Piece - Council's Emblem
6801937.description: A piece of intel with the emblem of the Arcane Council.

6801943.name: Long Spiritroot
6801943.description: A plant with slender roots that works as a mild catalyst.

6801944.name: Rainbow Flower
6801944.description: Rainbow flower in bloom after rain. Its scent can calm you down... or wake you up.

6801945.name: Plump Pine Cone
6801945.description: Unusually plump nuts and fragrant oils make it a go-to base for many mild remedies.

6801946.name: Party Flyer
6801946.description: A leaflet Pippa made about a chaos magic night party at the Solstice Hall.
6801946.story:
Calling all chaos magic enthusiasts!
A chaos magic party like no other awaits <style="highlight">tonight</style> at <style="highlight">Solstice Hall</style>! Cast the wildest spells imaginable! Conjuring a hamster out of thin air? Summoning a candy rain? Anything is possible!
Don't miss your chance to meet like-minded friends and uncover the secrets of chaos magic. See you tonight!

6801948.name: Cat Fur
6801948.description: Cat fur left behind after the ball ended abruptly, still humming with a familiar surge of magic.

6801949.name: Startear Essence
6801949.story:
Add these in order: starite powder, fish scale gel, and several drops of full moon dew.
Steps: First, pour a sufficient amount of <style="highlight">full moon dew</style> into a crucible.
Next, add the <style="highlight">starite powder</style> and stir it rapidly clockwise nine times with a silver stirrer.
Finally, add one teaspoon of <style="highlight">fish scale gel</style> and stir gently counterclockwise until faint sparks appear.

6801951.name: Enchanted Ring
6801951.description: A mysterious ring. Wear it and you might hear a voice in the distance... telling you to work overtime.

6801952.name: Flame Sword
6801952.description: A sword that can light a fire. Tied to an old legend.

6801953.name: Missing Notebook 1
6801953.description: A teacher's lost notebook, detailing field observations and speculation on a water Hypofiend.

6801954.name: Missing Notebook 2
6801954.description: A teacher's lost notebook, detailing the body structure of a water Hypofiend.

6801955.name: Missing Notebook 3
6801955.description: A teacher's lost notebook, detailing possible ways to communicate with a water Hypofiend.

6801956.name: Snowman
6801956.description: A snowman doll that's terrified of the cold. Melt it in the scorching land and maybe that's how you figure out the strange phenomenon.

6801957.name: Magic for Babies
6801957.description: Penned by the Magister Merlin! Warm words that lead young minds into a world of wonder.

6801958.name: Food Enlargement Extract
6801958.description: A special potion that enlarges food. Whether the calories grow too... Nobody knows. Yet.

6801959.name: Be a Cone Chef
6801959.description: Pippa's spellbook of pine-nut cooking. 108 different ways, all magically assisted, all ridiculously fast.

6801960.name: Clumsy Loveletter
6801960.description: Pirand's unsent letter to Hildi. Adorably clumsy, but needs some minor revisions.
6801960.story:
Dear Hildi,
My name is Pirand, and I've had a crush on you for quite some time.
I've been at the Lyceum for four years, but every time I see you, my spells just go haywire. Yesterday, I tried to conjure a rose for you and ended up with a talking cabbage instead. Rather than letting it do the talking, I think I should speak for myself.
Would you like to take a walk around the training grounds sometime? Or maybe hang out in the library? I could lend you my father's potion-making books with all his notes.
If you'd like to go on a little outing with me, turn your crucible anticlockwise three times during alchemy class. If not, turn it clockwise three times. Either way, no pressure—I'll respect your choice.

<align="right">Your friend (or maybe future boyfriend?), Pirand

6801961.name: Revised Loveletter
6801961.description: A polished loveletter. Hand it to Hildi, and see how the love story goes.
6801961.story:
The Starfall Lake draws its edges close in winter.
By the shore, I watch the fish swim in silence,
And joyful couples passing by, their youth a fleeting glimmer on the water's surface.
Meanwhile, I can only wonder which side of the sea holds you.
When I part the reeds that cloak my heart, I see you waiting there.
Everything falls into place, as if a long-forgotten, ancient spell has been cast.
The boundless sea within me recedes,
Shrinking into a lake to make room for your sky.

6801962.name: Lost Cat Notice
6801962.description: Have you seen me? The cat Snowy. If found, please go to the well near the Lumivale and contact Monjo.
6801962.story:
Urgent: Missing Cat!
Name: Snowy
Gender: Male
Description: White fur and friendly toward strangers. Performs a backflip when fed.

Snowy, my thirteen-year-old cat, ran away from home nine days ago after refusing to eat. I'm very worried about him! In human terms, he is roughly equivalent to a seventy-year-old and is in poor health due to frequent backflips.

If you happen to see or purchase him as a pet, please bring him to the well in Lumivale and contact Monjo. Your kindness will be generously rewarded!

6801963.name: Paper Sword
6801963.description: Every good knight's dream needs a sword, even if it's made of paper.

6801964.name: Hobbyhorse
6801964.description: A fine mount prepared for Knight Miguel.

6801965.name: Prop Helmet
6801965.description: It can't promise safety... just a sweet dream.

6801966.name: A Day in Our Routine
6801966.story:
Today, we once again helped a traveler lost in the forest.
As Talking Root retracted its spiky vines and lit the path with its glowing branches, I showed up at its cues to explain the forest's nature, calm the traveler, and guide them out.
That wasn't our first collaboration. After each successful rescue, I could sense Talking Root's relief, a serenity that made the forest breathe as one.
These days, Talking Root is brimming with vitality. It delights in watching the forest's creatures and dripping morning dew onto the birds' heads.
I hope it stays full of life forever and never knows loneliness in the years ahead.
Protecting this forest and seeing life thrive in magic alongside Talking Root is the life I've always dreamed of.

6801967.name: Perri's Last Letter
6801967.story:
Dear Talking Root,
By the time you read this letter, I may have already merged with the forest, maybe as a new patch of moss or a growing vine. It's natural to feel a little sad, but don't let grief overwhelm you.

I'm not gone forever, only existing in another form. Whenever the breeze brushes your face, the dew settles nearby, or the roots tremble, it is my whisper reaching you.

By the way, once you're feeling better, don't forget to visit the Serene Lyceum for treatment. The mages there will help you.

When you're well again, you will meet new friends who, like me, are eager to understand you.

Use your branches to ease their fear and your roots to steady the trembling ground, just as we once did.  

<align="right">Your eternal friend, Perri

6801968.name: Ghost Pet Food
6801968.description: They say even ghosts can taste it!

6801969.name: Oak Vintage
6801969.description: An aged fine wine saved for thirty years. The cork can't keep that rich aroma contained.

6801970.name: Repair Potion
6801970.description: A mild remedy that quickly mends minor damage in magical constructs, restoring their mana flow to order.

6801980.name: Chest
6801980.description: A wooden box dropped by a terrified little girl. Inside is a secret that matters more than she'll admit.

6801981.name: Wand
6801981.description: A wand left behind... and it may be tied to a suspicious death.

6801982.name: About Talking Root
6801982.story:
I named this towering tree <style="highlight">"Talking Root"</style>, in honor of the deepest connection between life and the land. This name is known only between the tree and me. <style="highlight">Anyone who can speak its name is deemed a trustworthy friend.</style> As the oldest tree in the forest, its roots have thrived in this magic-rich soil for centuries, allowing it to grow into a sentient, intelligent being.
Before I found it, it had been lonely and despondent, having no one in the forest to talk to.
I visit it regularly, sharing stories from the outside world and singing songs to revere the forest. It responds with the sway of its branches and the shifting patterns of its bark, expressing its emotions in its own language.
We have forged a special friendship, built on trust and companionship.

6801983.name: Best Fruit
6801983.description: Requested by the mysterious hamster. Place it at the tea party's marked spot if you want the best cake.

6801984.name: Forest Crisis Alert
6801984.story:
Recently, <style="highlight">a mysterious dark force has been corrupting the forest</style>, seeping into Talking Root's mind like a toxin.
Talking Root has grown disoriented and even occasionally <style="highlight">attacked nearby creatures indiscriminately</style>. Clearly, this loss of control is the result of the dark force.
Under my care, Talking Root has shown signs of recovery, but the corruption has taken a heavy toll on its strength.
Now, it spends most of its time in deep sleep, and its waking hours continue to grow shorter.
I have decided to stay in the forest and care for it until it fully recovers.

6801985.name: Wild Scalecone
6801985.description: Famous for its hard, scale-like husk. Inside are big, plump pine nuts with a rich resin aroma, making it an ideal snack every time.
6801985.comment: Watch your head when standing under a pine tree.

6801986.name: Wild Redbubble
6801986.description: A sweet-and-tart berry. One light bite and it goes pop in your mouth, just like a tiny red bubble.
6801986.comment: Carry with care. If all else fails, just skip the packing and eat it. Farm-to-belly, you know.

6801987.name: Lake Crab
6801987.description: Lake crab passed off as a fish king. Let's hope Pracel buys it.
6801987.comment: I'd bet this is almost spot-on for the "Startear-saturated Starglider" look.

6801992.name: Finn's Staff
6801992.description: An ordinary wand passed down through Finn's family. Not fancy, but it means something.

6801993.name: Custom Recipe

6801993.story:
Ingredients: <style="highlight">black tea</style>, <style="highlight">glimmerbloom leaves</style>, <style="highlight">laurel flowers</style>, and <style="highlight">honey</style>.
Instructions: Pour water into a pot and add the <style="highlight">laurel flowers</style>. Bring to a boil, then add <style="highlight">black tea</style> and <style="highlight">glimmerbloom leaves</style>. Once the mixture has cooled slightly, stir in a generous amount of <style="highlight">honey</style>.

6801994.description: Found in the headmaster's office. A seized note where students gushed about the new class-skipping spell.
6801994.comment: Given how this note turned up here... Yeah, it fell through, unfortunately.
6801994.story:
Have you seen ■■■■'s latest trick for ditching class? I think it might work. Want to try it next lesson?

<style="highlight">That spell's too advanced for me...</style>

Don't you want that limited-edition gadget that just hit the shelves?

<style="highlight">Alright, I'm sold! That gadget is mine! P.S. Don't pass this back, I think the professor has noticed us...</style>

(The messages end abruptly. Given where you found it, it is easy to infer what happened afterward...)

6801995.name: Revision Proposal
6801995.description: A school rules revision proposal drafted by the headmaster after the Herb Tea Incident.
6801995.comment: In short, he doesn't want to change a thing.
6801995.story:
Ah, yes, the <style="highlight">herbal tea incident</style>. A minor disaster, though I must admit, quite the spectacle! In the wake of it, dear <style="highlight">Zorya</style> and a few of our esteemed faculty members have proposed some rather inventive changes to our school rules.

One professor even suggested, and I quote, "At this rate, the students will blow the whole school up with their herbal tea!" Now, while I'm sure that's a bit of an exaggeration, the sight of a tea-flooded lecture hall was certainly unforgettable.

I do agree, though, that a revision is necessary.

So, here's my proposal: let's add water to the list of forbidden foods in Article 6, Clause 8. This, in theory, would make the brewing of herbal tea a tad more difficult, don't you think?

What say you, Professor Zorya? Does this solve our dilemma?

<style="highlight">... Such an unreasonable revision would lead to major disorder, Headmaster. It mustn't be passed.</style>

But this is the best solution I can think of, dear Zorya! If it's vetoed, we'll have no choice but to <style="highlight">put the revision on hold</style>.

<style="highlight">... Let's put it off then.</style>

7801938.name: Valen's Letter
7801938.story:
Dear Magister Merlin,

How are you holding up in Savannah? From what I hear, the place's been in utter chaos lately, with a temple vanishing, a missing princess, and that whole sword‑in‑the‑stone affair. Meanwhile, I'm sipping fine wine and catching wind of your exploits from hundreds of miles away. I must say, your stories are far juicier than any minstrel's tale!

Knowing you, I can already picture you working yourself to the bone to set things straight.
You're busy combing through every nook and cranny for hidden information, aren't you?

I know you'll likely brush this off, but still, I must warn you to keep your distance from the Solitaries.
Sure, they're just a harmless civilian organization, but dealing with them... is a real pain.
They don't care about gold or do things for favors; they only have their eyes on other people's secrets.
Be prepared to be stripped bare if you want anything from them. Honestly, I'd rather beat the answers out of them than sit through their questioning.

... But then again, you'd probably say it's worth going through all that if it means finding the truth.
Fine, if you insist on visiting them, I can point you to the right path—though whether it's the path you should take is another matter.

Make your way to <style="highlight">Vina Cemetery</style>, just outside the city.
<style="highlight">Seek out a unique coffin, open it, and lie down inside</style>.
Don't worry, it's just their special way of welcoming their guests. It's a bit cramped and stuffy inside, but just think of it as an early taste of your afterlife. After all, there are few quiet spots like this in Savannah.

Good luck, Magister. Hopefully, you'll still have a few secrets left when you climb out of that coffin.

Yours sincerely, Valen

7801988.name: Meeting Minutes
7801988.story:
Scribe: Adrian Crawley

Subject: Fortress Council Site Selection and Construction

Five days ago, our provisional command center came under another surprise attack. Thanks to timely reinforcements led by <style="highlight">Rion and Ryan</style>, we successfully repelled the assault. However, the Hypogeans' infiltration tactics have become increasingly sophisticated. With our command center now compromised, any further attack could prove catastrophic.

To address this issue, <style="highlight">Commander Rolan</style> proposed using our current command center as bait to ensnare the enemy. Meanwhile, a fully concealed and heavily fortified alternate command center will be built at a separate location.

Following extensive site surveys, the new command center will be established within a residential building in Savannah. The structure, abandoned during the war, offers an inconspicuous exterior while providing ample interior space. Minimal renovations are required to make it operationally functional.

In accordance with Commander Rolan's directives, the perimeter of the command center shall be covertly secured, and a specialized access mechanism will be installed at the entrance to restrict entry to senior officers only. All personnel involved in the refurbishment are prohibited from disclosing any details of the site.

Commander Rolan has designated the new command center the Fortress Council, a name chosen to reflect its role as an unassailable stronghold protecting our military interests.

May Dura's divine light restore peace to our homeland...

7801989.name: Battle Report
7801989.story:
Scribe: Oliver Emery

... When the Mirror Wraith appeared, darkness engulfed the battlefield as though all light had been consumed by its shadow. As countless Hypofiends surged forth, our morale collapsed to its lowest point.

Commander Rolan raised the sword granted by Dura and advanced alone to the front. "For our homeland!" His cry echoed across the plain.

Then came the miracle. Like the rising sun, Commander Rolan radiated a golden light that dispelled the fear gripping our soldiers' hearts.

The battle commenced. <style="highlight">General Reinhold, alongside vanguard commanders Rion and Ryan</style>, charged into the ranks of the Hypofiends like three bolts of lightning. They tore through the horde, opening a path for our main force to advance.

Commander Rolan engaged the Mirror Wraith in fierce combat, each swing of his blade imbued with sacred force. When the Mirror Wraith finally collapsed, the entire plain sank into deathly silence, shattered moments later by thunderous cheers from our soldiers.

Victory is ours this time, but the war is far from over.

Beneath the setting sun, Commander Rolan stood among the fallen, leaning upon his sword for support. His silhouette would echo through the ages as an undying legend.

7801991.name: Eternal Embrace
7801991.description: This signature dish of Silken Snare is said to be prepared exclusively for special guests.

7801997.name: Feathers
7801997.description: This soft, pristine feather was plucked from a swan who calls himself Lord Edward.

7801998.name: Twig
7801998.description: A slender, flexible branch commonly found throughout Savannah.

7801999.name: Lady Silvie's Gift
7801999.description: Made from a flexible branch and an exquisite swan feather, it sways gracefully like a bird in flight with the slightest wave. It holds a special appeal for a certain prominent figure.

7802000.name: Strange Card
7802000.story:
This is Merlin. Prince Orion has left Savannah for the time being, but his presence lingers in our hearts. As his trusted friend, I am secretly preparing for his return to power.

And I need sufficient resources to execute my grand plan!

Now, I am short of just 500 more gold to inscribe a magic circle powerful enough to bring the prince back in power.

If all goes well, the prince will return by ship to reclaim his throne. He will need your help—not merely as a supporter, but as one of his most trusted allies.

Each gold you contribute counts! Let us work together for His Highness' glorious return!

If you are willing to contribute, bring 500 gold to the docks in the commoners' district. Seek out a cargo ship bearing a staff emblem on its sail and hand the funds to my assistant. Prince Orion will arrive at the docks at dusk tomorrow to meet you.

Your friend,
Merlin

"Prince Orion's future lies in your hands!"

7802024.name: Pact
7802024.story:
I, Rowan of the Mithril Consortium, hereby make this formal declaration:
In the Grand Royal Supreme Card Tournament today, I suffered an unfortunate (and likely arranged) defeat at the hands of Princess Peggy.
I accept the loss and, of my own free will, shall unconditionally serve as Princess Peggy's errand boy for one day at any time she chooses in the future.

My duties shall include, but not limited to:
Carry bags (up to 10 kg).
Pay bills (only reasonable amounts and items).
Compliment Princess Peggy's wisdom and beauty whenever necessary (even if I don't mean it).

This serves as formal proof of my pledge.
<align="right">Debtor: Rowan (shaky signature)
<align="right">Creditor: Peggy (smug signature)

8202002.description: Recycle Lvl. 430-600 Season Equipment to obtain. It can be used to forge Lvl. 430-600 Season Equipment, and it will be removed when the season ends.
8202002.comment: A common forging stone with descent quality that is essential for equipment forging.

8202003.name: Season Forging Stone IV
8202003.description: Recycle Lvl. 610-760 Season Equipment to obtain. It can be used to forge Lvl. 610-760 Season Equipment. It will be removed when the season ends.
8202003.comment: A refined forging stone with a considerable price and quality.

8202004.name: Season Forging Stone V
8202004.description: Recycle Lvl. 770-900 Season Equipment to obtain. It can be used to forge Lvl. 770-900 Season Equipment, and it will be removed when the season ends.
8202004.comment: High quality forging stones are hard to find on the market.

8202005.name: Season Forging Stone VII
8202005.description: Recycle Lvl. 910-1,200 Season Equipment to obtain. It can be used to forge Lvl. 910-1,200 Season Equipment. It will be removed when the season ends.
8202005.comment: A precious forging stone imbued with divine power, and its scarcity is the only drawback.

8207001.name: Phantom Catalyst
8207001.description: Used to level up Phantimals from any faction in Soul Pact.

8207002.name: Phantom Vestige
8207002.description: Used to raise the level cap of Phantimals from any faction in Soul Pact.

8207003.name: Memory Vestige
8207003.description: Used to raise the level cap of Phantimals from any faction in Soul Pact.

8207004.name: Nexus Vestige
8207004.description: Used to raise the level cap of Phantimals from any faction in Soul Pact.

8207005.name: Phantimal Reshaper
8207005.description: Used to reset and swap Season Phantimal Levels.

8207098.name: Starfire Torch
8207098.description: Used to level up Stellar Union and unlock buffs for Guild modes.

8302129.name: Artifact Shard
8302129.description: Used to level up Season Artifacts to Lvl. 11-20.
8302129.comment: Memory fragments of old shed light on specific types of magic.

8302130.name: Memento Shard
8302130.description: Used to level up Season Artifacts to Lvl. 21-25.
8302130.comment: Memory fragments of old shed light on specific types of magic.

8302131.name: Oblivion Shard
8302131.description: Used to level up Season Artifacts to Lvl. 26-30.
8302131.comment: Memory fragments of old shed light on specific types of magic.

8302132.name: Candleflame Echo
8302132.description: Used to unlock the Season Artifact: Candleflame Spell. Grants an ally a candleflame that continuously restores HP to nearby allies.
8302132.comment: A memory lost somewhere triggers the recollection of a magical technique.

8302133.name: Tidesurge Echo
8302133.description: Used to unlock the Season Artifact: Tidesurge Spell. Periodically increases allies' ATK, Penetration, and ATK SPD.
8302133.comment: A memory lost somewhere triggers the recollection of a magical technique.

8302134.name: Soulshock Echo
8302134.description: Used to unlock the Season Artifact: Soulshock Spell. Periodically stuns enemies, deals magic damage, and reduces their stats for a duration.
8302134.comment: A memory lost somewhere triggers the recollection of a magical technique.

8302135.name: Meteorfall Echo
8302135.description: Used to unlock the Season Artifact: Meteorfall Spell. Calls down a meteor after allied heroes cast a set number of Ultimates. Each cast enhances subsequent casts.
8302135.comment: A memory lost somewhere triggers the recollection of a magical technique.

8302136.name: Healwind Echo
8302136.description: Used to unlock the Season Artifact: Healwind Spell. Stores life energy and continuously restores HP to low-HP allies.
8302136.comment: A memory lost somewhere triggers the recollection of a magical technique.

8302137.name: Thundermight Echo
8302137.description: Used to unlock the Season Artifact: Thundermight Spell. Periodically fires separate chains of lightning at the frontmost and rearmost enemies, dealing magic damage.
8302137.comment: A memory lost somewhere triggers the recollection of a magical technique.

8302138.name: Bladesummon Echo
8302138.description: Used to unlock the Season Artifact: Bladesummon Spell. Summons a portal after allied heroes deal normal attack damage a set number of times. The portal continuously launches flying swords at the frontmost enemy and increases their damage taken for a duration.
8302138.comment: A memory lost somewhere triggers the recollection of a magical technique.

8302139.name: Soulbound Echo
8302139.description: Used to unlock the Season Artifact: Soulbound Spell. Designates the frontmost ally as the vanguard, increasing allies' damage dealt based on the vanguard's traits.
8302139.comment: A memory lost somewhere triggers the recollection of a magical technique.

8302140.name: Bladestorm Echo
8302140.description: Used to unlock the Season Artifact: Bladestorm Spell. Creates a ring of blades around each allied hero, dealing damage to nearby enemies and increasing their melee damage taken for a duration.
8302140.comment: A memory lost somewhere triggers the recollection of a magical technique.

8302141.name: Hurricane Echo
8302141.description: Used to unlock the Season Artifact: Hurricane Spell. Periodically summons a hurricane that knocks enemies back and increases allies' ranged damage.
8302141.comment: A memory lost somewhere triggers the recollection of a magical technique.

8302142.name: Synergy Echo
8302142.description: Used to unlock the Season Artifact: Synergy Spell. Grants allies different buffs based on the number of different classes deployed.
8302142.comment: A memory lost somewhere triggers the recollection of a magical technique.

8302143.name: Coreforge Echo
8302143.description: Used to unlock the Season Artifact: Coreforge Spell. Creates a magic sigil beneath the rearmost ally, granting them buffs while they stay on it.
8302143.comment: A memory lost somewhere triggers the recollection of a magical technique.

8802041.name: Large Boneshroom
8802041.description: Shaped like a skeletal arm, this mushroom has grown unusually large over the years.
8802041.comment: It feels just like the skin of the living.

8802042.name: Dried Spiritroot
8802042.description: In Graveborn territory, spiritroot takes on an altered hue.

8802043.name: Soulsever Potion
8802043.description: This potion temporarily separates the soul from the body. It is effective on both the living and the Graveborn.
8802043.comment: Make sure nothing goes wrong when making this potion!

8802044.name: Letter Scrap 1
8802044.description: Found in the golden maple tree hollow, these appear to be fragments of a letter Hilda wrote to Bessie before losing her sanity.

8802045.name: Letter Scrap 2
8802045.description: Found in the golden maple tree hollow, these appear to be fragments of a letter Hilda wrote to Bessie before losing her sanity.

8802046.name: Letter Scrap 3
8802046.description: Found in the golden maple tree hollow, these appear to be fragments of a letter Hilda wrote to Bessie before losing her sanity.

8802050.name: Red Moth
8802050.description: Tephesia keeps these moths in a hidden greenhouse. Their wings bear eye-like patterns, and they are used to make the antidote for candle blossom infection.
8802050.comment: Watch its scales cascade down in a soft flurry.

8802051.name: Access Crystal
8802051.description: When enchanted, this access crystal from Tephesia's bedroom can teleport you to the Adamant Syndicate HQ.

8802053.name: Wild Tidesong Conch
8802053.description: When the full moon rises, you can hear whispers from the deep sea through it.
8802053.comment: It is ideal for crafting a speaking tube.

8802054.name: Wild Boneshroom
8802054.description: Rumor has it that this arm-shaped white mushroom will grab any living person who steps on it, though it is merely a tale spun by the Graveborn.
8802054.comment: Shaking hands with it is certainly a bizarre experience.

8802055.name: Wild Gem Pepper
8802055.description: Beneath its tough, shriveled skin are plenty of plump, moist seeds.
8802055.comment: How can there be so many seeds inside?

8802056.name: Wild Netherhand
8802056.description: An extremely rare and valuable plant. If you look closely, you will notice that its roots are embedded in a dead insect.
8802056.comment: Best eaten with the roots removed.

8802057.name: Wild Candle Blossom
8802057.description: Most Graveborn steer clear of these vibrant red flowers, which grow in abundance throughout the Gravebloom Fields.
8802057.comment: It's the beauty that lures you into danger.

8802058.name: Pungent Potion
8802058.description: Harmless in appearance, yet it leaves behind a strong, long-lasting scent.
8802058.comment: You can catch its scent from miles away.

8802059.name: Deeproot Powder
8802059.description: Ground from roots buried deep underground, this powder gives off a faint fluorescent glow.

8802060.name: Peace Moss
8802060.description: One whiff of its rotten stench is enough to numb your sense of smell.
8802060.comment: Numbness is one way to find peace, right?

8802061.name: Twilight Resin
8802061.description: Drops of resin that have captured the hues of twilight.

8802062.name: Enchanted Twilight Resin
8802062.description: Mana gives the resin an ethereal gleam.

8802063.name: Calming Elixir
8802063.description: It has the same soothing effect as the still, quiet depths of the ocean.
8802063.comment: Works just as well on those who fear the sea.

8802064.name: Arcane Reagent Powder
8802064.description: This powder transmits mana, and the trace amount it retains accounts for its distinctive coloration.

8802065.name: Meteor Dust
8802065.description: These meteorite fragments will only shine again under the right conditions.
8802065.comment: Determining whether it is genuine is no easy task.

8802066.name: Ocean Mercury
8802066.description: This deep-sea gemstone contains trace amounts of mercury and an immense amount of mana.
8802066.comment: It is an essential material for making chronostatin.

8802067.name: Senea's Memory Star
8802067.description: Senea's memories are preserved within this Memory Star.
8802067.comment: "May I never forget who I am."

8802068.name: Exquisite Ring
8802068.description: This ring was found clutched tightly in Doctor Bentley's hand. It likely belonged to his killer.
8802068.comment: It seems to be worth a fortune.

8802069.name: Key From Bentley
8802069.description: Doctor Bentley never let go of this key, not even as he drew his last breath.

8802070.name: Key From Marl
8802070.description: This key was found on Marl, the ship's first mate. It is unclear what it unlocks.

8802071.name: Onions
8802071.description: These onions from the Tempest's kitchen don't look very fresh.

8802072.name: Beans
8802072.description: These beans have been sitting in the Tempest's kitchen for who knows how long.

8802073.name: Death Orb
8802073.description: This gemstone is said to have once adorned the tip of the God of Death's staff, yet it seems to hold no mana at all...
8802073.comment: Would the God of Death really fancy something like this?

8802075.name: Half Gear (Left)
8802075.description: Half of a gear that seems to have fallen off some kind of machine.

8802076.name: Half Gear (Right)
8802076.description: Half of a gear that seems to have fallen off some kind of machine.

8802077.name: Coldmoon Nectar
8802077.description: This nectar is gathered by bees that only emerge under moonlight, and it tastes far sweeter than ordinary nectar.

8802081.name: Wild Spiritroot
8802081.description: Some claim that consuming spiritroot allows communication with the dead, but in truth, it will lead to your own demise.
8802081.comment: Desperate to talk to the departed? Fine, eat it... Look for it out in the world, but don't say I didn't warn you...

8802082.name: Wild Moonbloom Clam
8802082.description: The locals call it the jolly clam because of the smiling face pattern on its shell. When cooked, it tastes delicious and is a popular home-cooked dish in Rustport.
8802082.comment: Be careful not to overindulge, as it can lead to uncontrollable laughter.

8802083.name: Twisted Branch
8802083.description: As close as you can get to a real arm.

8802084.name: Broken Skull
8802084.description: As close as you can get to a real head.

8802085.name: Dry Leaves
8802085.description: Stuff them inside the pumpkin ghost and let them rustle with its every movement.

8802086.name: Disguise-Removing Potion
8802086.description: Brewed from a recipe provided by the Adamant Syndicate, this potion can remove the Graveborn disguise from the stowaways.
8802086.comment: Trust your enemies when the situation calls for it.

8802087.name: Overripe Gem Pepper
8802087.description: This overripe pepper is packed with pearl-like seeds and gives off an intense aroma.

8802088.name: Blooming Candle Blossom
8802088.description: These blood-red blooms are an unsettling sight across the land of the Graveborn.

8802089.name: Lumber Logs
8802089.description: These logs are harvested from felled trees and can be used to make barricades and rolling logs.

8802090.name: Enchanted Knife
8802090.description: Hilda's keepsake, found in the hollow of a massive golden maple tree. It serves as a token of the friendship between Hilda and Bessie.
8802090.comment: Death may come again and again, but our bond will endure.

8802091.name: Amnesia Cure
8802091.description: Tephesia and the Adamant Syndicate jointly developed this cure for soul cocoons with erased memories.

8802092.name: Empty Soul Inhibitor Bottle
8802092.description: This bottle, labeled "Soul Inhibitor", is empty now.
8802092.comment: Who used it? And on whom?

8802093.name: Old Sea Salt
8802093.description: This sea salt from Twilight Village has grown damp over time. Thankfully, spoiled food can't kill a Graveborn twice.
8802093.comment: It may no longer be safe to eat, but that hardly matters to the Graveborn.

8802094.name: Refinery Key I
8802094.description: This Graveborn-style key can be used to unlock one of the doors in the Refinery.
8802094.comment: The eye on the key's handle seems to be watching you.

8802095.name: Refinery Key II
8802095.description: This Graveborn-style key can be used to unlock one of the doors in the Refinery.
8802095.comment: The eye on the key's handle seems to be watching you.

8802097.name: Refinery Key III
8802097.description: This Graveborn-style key can be used to unlock one of the doors in the Refinery.
8802097.comment: The eye on the key's handle seems to be watching you.

8802099.name: Bone Token
8802099.description: This uniquely engraved bone token serves as proof that you work at the Repair House and grants you access to the Gravebloom Fields.

8802104.name: Senea's Photo Album
8802104.description: The first collection of stills published after Senea's passing, eagerly sought after by countless fans of the play.
8802104.comment: Her presence is as captivating as ever.

8802112.name: Aurelia Starfish Clues
8802112.story:
Aurelia Starfish is an unusual creature capable of mimicking sunlight. It was once kept at Mortimer Manor to help the blood thralls ease their discomfort from prolonged lack of sunlight.
Tephesia later dismissed the blood thralls and had the Aurelia Starfish released along the <style="highlight">shore</style> of Darkmire Cliff. They dwell in the dark depths of the sea and surface only during a <style="highlight">full moon</style>.

8802113.name: Strange Machine
8802113.description: "Buzz... Crackle... Hi, you're listening... to the radio station..."

8802118.name: Lost Voice Music Box
8802118.description: A custom music box commissioned by the Seasong Theater to commemorate the first anniversary of Senea's passing. It plays the theme song from Lost Voice.

10000000.name: Sunward Bloom
10000000.description: A flower that thrives in the light, storing light energy within its petals.

10000001.name: Wheat
10000001.description: A staple crop, easy to grow and perfect for a hearty meal.

10000002.name: Emberleaf
10000002.description: A spicy plant from arid lands, known for its fiery kick.

10000003.name: Grape
10000003.description: A sweet and sour fruit, perfect for a refreshing snack.

10000004.name: Mistletoe
10000004.description: A calming herb, often used to soothe the mind and spirit.

10000005.name: Fuzzy Mushroom
10000005.description: A subterranean mushroom, must be properly cooked before consumption.

10000006.name: Mandrake Root
10000006.description: A bitter herb that can cause hallucinations. It is not for the faint of heart.

10000007.name: Flamefern
10000007.description: A fiery herb with a sweet and spicy flavor, imbued with flame power.

10000008.name: Corn
10000008.description: A hardy crop that thrives in almost all environments.

10000009.name: Scorpion Stinger
10000009.description: Its scorpion-like tail looks menacing, but it's completely harmless.

10000010.name: Nightshroom
10000010.description: An incredibly hard mushroom that can also be mined for ore.

10000011.name: Tune Sprout
10000011.description: A plant rich in flavor that grows in damp soil.

10000012.name: Foxtail Grass
10000012.description: A common alchemy herb, prized for its invigorating properties.

10000013.name: Moon Dew
10000013.description: A tiny fruit that glimmers like moonlit dew on the fields. Tastes incredibly sweet.
10000013.comment:
May be found when harvesting crops from Fields.
Daily Limit: 1,500.

10000014.name: Chime Berry
10000014.description: A bright, sweet berry that ripens in spring. A favorite among children.
10000014.comment:
Chance to obtain through fields.
Daily Limit: 1,000.

10000100.name: Raw Ore
10000100.description: Unrefined ore, rich with hidden treasures waiting to be uncovered.

10000101.name: Mossstone
10000101.description: A springtime stone covered in fluffy green moss. It's perfect for carving small decorative crafts.
10000101.comment:
Chance to obtain through mines.
Daily Limit: 1,000.

10000200.name: Log
10000200.description: Untreated wood, ready for crafting or burning.

10000300.name: Leyline Essence
10000300.description: Magical energy scattered through the geo leylines. Gathered and refined to craft magical items.

10000301.name: Dreamy Sunglow
10000301.description: A curious magical material. At first glance, it radiates with the warmth of a fresh sunrise, but the longer you hold its gaze, the more the light softens into a drifting, dreamlike haze.
10000301.comment:
Chance to obtain through Elemental Altars
Daily Limit: 1,000.

10000400.name: Mirage Orb
10000400.description: A mystical orb, said to store dreams and glow with an eerie light.
10000400.comment: Essential material for crafting rare decorations.

10000401.name: Shadow Jade
10000401.description: A rare mineral found alongside ancient trees, imbued with captivating magic.
10000401.comment: Essential material for crafting high-level decorations.

10000402.name: Celesta Lunabelle Shard
10000402.description: A mysterious shard infused with Celesta Lunabelle's power. Collect enough to obtain the Celesta Lunabelle decoration.
10000402.comment: Used to redeem the Celesta Lunabelle decoration in the Moonlit Store. Obtainable by defeating pastry thieves, opening Frosted Delights, etc.

10000403.name: Lunabelle Shard
10000403.description: A mysterious shard infused with Lunabelle's power. Collect enough to obtain Lunabelle decorations.
10000403.comment: Used to redeem Lunabelle decorations and parts of the Lunar Autumn decoration set in the Moonlit Store.

10000404.name: Moonlit Coin
10000404.description: A mysterious token granted by Lunabelle, symbolizing the blessings of the moonlit night.
10000404.comment: A token used in the Moonlit Avalon event store.

10000405.name: Battle Token
10000405.description: A special token used to fight pastry bandits. Deliciousness never compromises!
10000405.comment: A token used to challenge Pastry Thieves in the Moonlit Avalon event. Restores 2 each day and can also be redeemed in limited quantities from the event store.

10000406.name: Frosted Delights
10000406.description: Used to treat Lunabelles. In return, they'll grant you a special gift that contains 4-Star Lunar Pastry Box x3 and Celesta Lunabelle Shard x2, with a 2.70% chance to include the Celesta Lunabell decoration. A Celesta Lunabelle decoration is guaranteed within 60 gifts, and obtaining one resets the counter.
10000406.comment: A box of sugary sweets and pastries, perfect for serving to Lunabelles.

10000407.name: Avalon Coin
10000407.description: Use this coin to exchange for decorations from Mr. Stewart's Treasure Trove.
10000407.comment: A coin with crystal‑like edges, engraved with the divine light that protects Avalon.

10000408.name: Light Fragment
10000408.description: Shards from the crystal that once crowned the Radiant Spire, infused with light power strong enough to dispel darkness and corruption.

10001000.name: Stone Block
10001000.description: Basic stone material, essential for building and crafting.

10001001.name: Red Copper
10001001.description: A common reddish metal, useful for a wide variety of tools and items.

10001002.name: Rock Salt
10001002.description: A simple yet essential seasoning, adding flavor to any dish.

10001003.name: Arcanite
10001003.description: A rare, pure mineral from ancient ruins, often used in crafting magical items.

10001004.name: Rose Salt
10001004.description: A refined salt with a floral hue and delicate aroma.

10001006.name: Onyx Salt
10001006.description: A pure, high-quality salt with a refined taste and rich aroma.

10001007.name: Mithril
10001007.description: A magical metal, prized for its mystical properties.

10001008.name: Whiteridge Sulfur
10001008.description: A rare mineral from Whiteridge, known for its healing properties.

10001009.name: Brimstone Alloy
10001009.description: A strong, durable metal alloy favored by dwarf artisans.

10001010.name: Moon Fluorite
10001010.description: A stone imbued with nature's blessings, often found in clear waters.

10001011.name: Crimson Gemstone
10001011.description: A precious ore that yields a metal highly resistant to heat and corrosion.

10001012.name: Moon Spark
10001012.description: A mineral resembling dust formed from condensed moonlight, shimmering with iridescent light.

10002000.name: Timber
10002000.description: An essential material for building and crafting.

10002001.name: Firewood
10002001.description: A simple fuel, ideal for starting fires or cooking.
